raw.excerpt: Position OverviewFujifilm's consumer e-commerce business runs on a composable stack: commercetools for commerce, a headless front end, a product personalization engine, Klaviyo for lifecycle marketing, and supporting tools for content, search, analytics, and customer support.
raw.description:
Position Overview

Fujifilm's consumer e-commerce business runs on a composable stack: commercetools for commerce, a headless front end, a product personalization engine, Klaviyo for lifecycle marketing, and supporting tools for content, search, analytics, and customer support. This role keeps that stack running well day to day and helps shape where it goes next.

The Manager, E-Commerce Platforms is the team's hands-on owner for platform administration and vendor operations across our direct-to-consumer (DTC) storefronts. You will administer our SaaS tools, manage day-to-day vendor relationships, and support evaluations of new components such as CMS, search, and marketing tools. You will take operational vendor work off the Senior Director's plate so the department can focus on strategy and growth.

This is a strong fit for someone with a few years of platform or marketing technology experience who wants to grow into composable commerce architecture and vendor strategy. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Analytics, Marketing, IT, Procurement, Legal, and our systems integrator partners.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one-time-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Responsibilities

Platform administration

  • Administer platform settings, user access, roles, environments, API credentials, and integrations across commercetools, Klaviyo, and related SaaS tools.
  • Manage license and seat counts, usage-based costs, and platform spend against budget.
  • Coordinate vendor-driven changes such as version upgrades, deprecations, and new feature rollouts.
  • Keep administration procedures, runbooks, and access records documented and audit-ready.

Vendor management

  • Serve as the day-to-day contact for SaaS vendors: support tickets, escalations, account reviews, and roadmap briefings.
  • Track contracts, renewal dates, and SLAs, and flag cost or risk issues to the Senior Director early.
  • Prepare renewal and contract materials for Procurement and Legal.
  • Coordinate with systems integrator partners on platform configuration and admin tasks, alongside Product Owners.

Sourcing and evaluation

  • Support evaluations of new composable components: gather requirements, build vendor shortlists, schedule demos, and run scoring.
  • Research the market for headless CMS, search, marketing automation, and other composable tools, and summarize options and trade-offs.
  • Maintain a current map of the stack: components, integrations, data flows, owners, contracts, and renewal dates.

Direct-to-consumer and marketing tools

  • Act as technical admin for Klaviyo and other marketing tools: integration health, data feeds, event tracking, and consent settings.
  • Work with Marketing and Analytics so customer, order, and behavioral data flows correctly between commerce, email, and analytics tools.
  • Help launch new DTC capabilities such as personalization, loyalty, reviews, and on-site search improvements.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Give Product Owners and Business Analysts input on requirements that touch platform capabilities or vendor limits.
  • Work with IT and Security on access reviews, vendor security assessments, and compliance requirements.

Required Skills/Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3 to 4 years of experience in e-commerce technology, platform administration, digital product, or marketing technology.
  • Hands-on administration of at least one e-commerce platform (commercetools, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, or similar) or marketing automation platform (Klaviyo, Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar).
  • Day-to-day experience working with SaaS vendors on support, account management, or renewals.
  • Took part in at least one software evaluation or vendor selection.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and data flows between commerce, marketing, and analytics systems. Coding not required.
  • Strong organization and documentation habits.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Desired Skills

  • Hands-on experience with both a commerce platform and a marketing automation platform.
  • Exposure to headless or composable commerce (MACH) architecture.
  • commercetools or Klaviyo certification.
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Contentstack, Amplience, Storyblok, or similar) or search tools (Algolia, Elasticsearch, Bloomreach, Constructor, or similar).
  • Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and customer support platforms such as Intercom.
  • Experience working with offshore or nearshore systems integrators.
  • Exposure to consumer privacy and compliance requirements (CCPA/CPRA, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, PCI, accessibility).
  • Background in consumer products, photo, or DTC retail.

Current stack: commercetools, Frontastic, Mediaclip, Klaviyo, Google Tag Manager, GA4, Intercom.

Salary and Benefits

  • $96,000.00 plus bonus depending on experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off

EEO Information

Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc.

This position is created specifically to assist with Humana’s efforts to secure and, if awarded, transition into a new business opportunity. In the event Humana does not pursue the opportunity or determines that a timely and satisfactory transition cannot be achieved, employment may be subject to termination.

The Senior Process Improvement Professional serves as the end-to-end process owner and subject matter expert for interoperability and medical documentation chase operations. This role will assess business needs, design new workflows, define operating models, and develop process standards, controls, and performance measures to support successful implementation. The associate will partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and IT to document requirements for system functionality, identify dependencies, and ensure technology solutions align to operational needs.

The Senior Process Improvement Professional will map current and future-state processes, identify gaps, risks, and opportunities, and recommend sustainable solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and stakeholder experience. This role will help establish business rules, intake requirements, routing logic, exception handling, reporting needs, and governance processes for new work. The associate will also support change management, implementation planning, testing, and operational readiness activities to ensure successful launch and adoption.


The role requires developing deep expertise across the full end-to-end process, including upstream inputs, downstream impacts, stakeholder roles, system touchpoints, and compliance considerations. The Senior Process Improvement Professional makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding process design, requirements, and implementation approach, and performs work with limited direction while exercising considerable latitude in determining objectives and methods.


Use your skills to make an impact

raw.description:
SwingDev—a hippo company is the Polish branch of a fast-growing InsurTech product company – Hippo Insurance. We’re here to make home insurance smarter and more proactive, using tech to bring fresh solutions. We also create digital products that support our customers, always focusing on what really makes an impact.
Putting a lot of effort into hiring top-tier professionals is a proof that we care a lot about tech experience, the attitude, human approach, and what we could call „culture fit”.
„SwingDev is all about people” - yes, it may sound a bit cliche. But whether we're writing code or just hanging out, we know that people are at the heart of everything we do. We like to have a good time and keep things light, even when we're tackling big projects. We could brag about what’s making us special, but we’ve boiled it down to two key ingredients: mature, companionable people who, rather than compete, prefer to inspire and have each other’s backs; a culture of trust, empathy, and positivity that keeps us together, lets us interact as teammates and friends, and truly enjoy the ride.
So if you're a Senior QA Engineer looking to shake things up and have a good time while you're at it, you’ve come to the right place. 🚀

About the role:

Join the Service Charter team, the group behind Hippo's contact center and customer data platform – the systems our service, operations, and partner teams rely on every day to support customers and agencies.

We own the full stack that powers customer interactions: the gateways that route calls into the right programs, the services that manage contact center and agency customer data, and the workers and data pipelines that ingest call data from platforms like NICE and Strada. You'll work across backend services, event-driven workers, and scheduled data runners – designing systems that are reliable, scalable, and central to how Hippo serves its customers.

As part of the Growth & CX domain, you'll collaborate closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and operations teams, getting hands-on exposure to business-critical workflows like call routing, contact center analytics, agency prequoting automation, and large-scale customer data management.

What will you do?

  • You'll deeply collaborate with Engineering teams. This includes actively participating in the development of new features and initiatives, from initial requirement analysis and test planning to execution, regression testing, and final release sign-off.
  • You'll partner closely with Product Managers. This means you will be responsible for prioritizing testing efforts, clarifying requirements, challenging assumptions from a quality perspective, coordinating Business Acceptance Testing, and advocating for the needs of our customers.
  • You'll collaborate with other manual QA engineers on cross-team and cross-BU projects, to expand and maintain our test coverage for new features and regression testing.
  • You'll proactively identify and mitigate potential risks, ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.

We might be a match if you…

  • Have 5+ years of QA experience, with a focus on manual testing (Black Box, White Box, and Grey Box).
  • Have a good knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Have a good understanding of testing integration, functional, end-to-end, and API tests (Postman).
  • Have experience with test case design, execution, and reporting for complex systems (front-end and back-end).
  • Have an ability to create test cases and collections that exercise the requirements and business rules in colaboration with PMs.
  • Worked with test case management tools (preferably XRay).
  • Have good analytical skills and attention to detail.

raw.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the TeamAs part of the Accounts team, you will be working with a group of talented and friendly individuals. Our goal is to deliver and maintain the performant, resilient, accurate, best-in-class software platform to drive player registration and authentication, identity verification (KYC), fraud and AML checks, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming enforcement, regulatory enforcement, and player communications (push, email, SMS) that is at the core of everything we do as a company. As a result, our stakeholders span the entire range of the business, and we must support them with whatever they are required to deliver without sacrificing the quality and performance we strive to maintain. This will include building a lot of cross-service integrations, with internal and external stakeholders. We are also hyper-vigilant about software performance, resilience, reliability, and accuracy, constantly tracking risks and regressions on all fronts, and proposing improvements where opportunities exist. The systems we own are among the most business-critical at PENN: every player signup, login, identity check, and responsible gaming decision runs through them, and getting them right is a regulatory obligation, not just an engineering goal.

About the Work

  • Design, scale, and performance-tune REST APIs, low-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries powering player registration and authentication (OAuth2, MFA, biometrics), identity verification, fraud and AML screening, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming and self-exclusion enforcement, regulatory reporting, and player notifications, among other things.
  • Own technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, drafting proposals and presenting them to leadership and partner teams for feedback
  • Design, architect, and deliver new features end-to-end in a collaborative agile/scrum environment
  • Identify bottlenecks and areas of risk in production, and drive the changes that make the platform more scalable
  • Set up and refine monitoring and alerting in Datadog for the systems you own
  • Mentor engineers on the team and across teams that ship into our codebase, through specs, pairing, and code review
  • Interact with multiple stakeholders across a wide variety of business domains to deliver best in class products, operational improvements, and cost efficiency optimizations.
  • Be comfortable with bridging the gap between internal, third party (identity verification, fraud, geolocation, and messaging vendors), legacy, and modern systems; and excel at doing what this entails, including, data migrations, intermediate data translation, the building and stewardship of additional supporting infrastructure as required, etc.
  • Other duties as required.

About You

  • You possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Software engineering
  • A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms, and software design
  • Strong grasp of production systems at scale, and experience identifying areas of improvement in a production environment through load testing and tracing
  • Experience investigating and remediating production performance regressions, including CPU, I/O, and memory hotspots as well as latency regressions in high-throughput services
  • Experience with on-call rotations for a production service, including owning release cycles end-to-end
  • Passionate about clean code architecture and software craftsmanship
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring tech specs, runbooks, and cross-team design docs that stand up to scrutiny
  • Experience with modern web frameworks and API development (Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel, Node)
  • A strong grasp of relational databases, including PostgreSQL and MySQL. Additionally, a strong understanding of relational database theory, including, but not limited to, normalization and denormalization, particularly from a flexibility vs performance mindset, is a major asset.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and comfort operating services in a containerized environment
  • Comfortable working in the terminal, with Git and GitHub or similar, and in an editor of your choice
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as ExUnit, RSpec, Jest, pytest, or equivalent
  • Experience with background job processing (Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery, Beanstalkd)
  • Experience with asynchronous event handling infrastructure (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub)
  • Experience with agentic software development tools, building and using agentic workflows, and validating quality of agentic outputs is a major asset.
  • Experience with building authentication, identity, or other regulated systems with strong security and auditability is paramount.
  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA) and secure handling of PII.
  • Experience integrating third-party KYC, fraud, geolocation, or messaging providers (e.g., push, email, SMS) is an asset.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience building applications in Elixir, hexagonal architecture, Domain-Driven Design, contribution to open source software, experience working at startups, passion for sports and/or esports
  • Experience with building financial, legal, and / or process accounting systems with strong correctness and auditability
  • Experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for product surfaces used by multiple clients (iOS, Android, Web) is an asset.
  • Experience building and integrating multi-client / white-label platforms, including geo-based routing and per-jurisdiction configuration
  • Familiarity with gaming regulatory requirements across jurisdictions (e.g., AGCO, DGE) and responsible gaming controls is an asset.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation package

• Fun, relaxed work environment

• Education and conference reimbursements.

Job Title: Clinical Chart Abstractor - Pulmonary Rehabilitation

Classification: Part Time/1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Hours/Schedule: 15-20 hours per week, flexible, morning or afternoon hours (ET)

Team: Clinical Operations

Reporting to: Program Manager

Location: United States

Compensation: $27-$30 per hour

Job Summary

The Clinical Chart Abstractor – Pulmonary Rehabilitation is responsible for reviewing patient electronic medical records (EMRs) to determine medical eligibility or ineligibility for Aviary Health’s virtual pulmonary rehabilitation program.

This role supports the enrollment team by reviewing medical histories, identifying qualifying pulmonary diagnoses, interpreting relevant clinical documentation, and verifying that referral requirements are met. The Clinical Chart Abstractor will document eligibility determinations, identify missing information, and coordinate follow-up to support timely patient enrollment.

Responsibilities

  • Provide daily chart review support to the enrollment team by evaluating patient medical records for pulmonary rehabilitation eligibility and ineligibility.
  • Review pulmonary diagnoses, relevant medical history, pulmonary function test (PFT) results, and other clinical documentation to determine whether patients meet established program eligibility criteria.
  • Identify qualifying pulmonary conditions, including COPD, emphysema, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and other eligible respiratory conditions, as defined by program guidelines.
  • Review ICD-10 codes and supporting clinical documentation to confirm eligibility according to established inclusion and exclusion criteria.
  • Identify existing pulmonary rehabilitation referral orders and coordinate the creation or completion of referral documentation when needed.
  • Verify referral requirements, including appropriate ordering provider credentials, signatures, and cosignatures when applicable.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or conflicting clinical documentation and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate team members.
  • Communicate eligibility determinations, ineligibility reasons, and outstanding documentation requirements to the enrollment team through concise, accurate documentation in designated platforms.
  • Maintain organized, accurate records of chart reviews and eligibility decisions within the EMR and other designated systems.
  • Escalate cases that fall outside established eligibility guidelines or require additional clinical review to the appropriate clinician or program leadership.
  • Assist with special projects related to pulmonary rehabilitation enrollment, chart abstraction, and clinical operations as needed.
  • This position requires strong attention to detail, the ability to interpret clinical documentation, and the ability to make timely, consistent eligibility determinations using established guidelines and decision trees.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of clinical experience in pulmonary care, respiratory therapy, exercise physiology, cardiac or pulmonary rehabilitation, or chronic disease management.
  • Experience reviewing electronic medical records and interpreting clinical documentation.
  • Familiarity with pulmonary conditions, particularly COPD, emphysema, and other chronic respiratory diseases.
  • Working knowledge of pulmonary function tests, spirometry, and relevant diagnostic terminology.
  • Ability to interpret ICD-10 codes and apply established clinical eligibility criteria.
  • At least 3 years of experience with EPIC or another electronic medical record system.
  • At least 2 years of experience with medical terminology and clinical chart review.
  • Proficient computer skills, including experience with Google Workspace, Zoom, and electronic medical record systems.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to summarize clinical findings and eligibility decisions clearly and accurately.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks independently.
  • Ability to recognize cases requiring clarification or escalation rather than making assumptions when documentation is incomplete.
  • Experience with clinical eligibility review, referral coordination, or healthcare enrollment operations preferred.

Requirements

  • Citrix access.
  • EPIC access, including RTE, as applicable to assigned responsibilities.
  • Google Workspace.
  • Zoom.
  • Microsoft Teams, including participation in GHS EPIC training when applicable.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for confidential clinical work and participation in virtual meetings.
  • Availability for required eligibility/enrollment team meetings.
  • Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and comply with applicable privacy and security requirements.

*Note: This is a 1099 contractor position

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Product Manager, Degree Programs in the USA Product team, you’ll own TripleTen’s new online Master’s in Applied AI end to end: its positioning, why students choose it, and how it runs day to day. We’re launching the program with an accredited US college, and you’ll be the main bridge between the college and our product, marketing, and sales teams. You’ll work directly with the college’s leadership and faculty, so the role runs fully in English.

What you will do

  • Own the program as a product. Set the vision, roadmap, key metrics, and unit economics model for the online MS in Applied AI.
  • Prioritize what to build. Turn student, market, and partner insights into clear priorities, and decide what ships first.
  • Own the student experience. Shape the journey from application and onboarding to graduation, and fix friction points using student feedback and data.
  • Set learning experience requirements. Define class schedule, live and self-paced mix, project formats, and review turnaround standards with the curriculum and operations teams.
  • Run product research. Interview hiring managers and students, and analyze competing online Master’s degrees, AI bootcamps, and certificates.
  • Shape the value proposition. Define and test positioning with marketing and sales, and equip them with briefs, FAQs, and answers to student objections.
  • Manage the university partnership. Be the main contact for the college’s leadership, faculty, and admissions; run syncs, negotiate, and resolve issues early.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in product management, including 2+ in EdTech, online education, or B2C subscription. You work with funnels and unit economics, build financial models, and decide from data.
  • Positioning and partnerships. You’ve built value propositions with marketing and sales and driven shared decisions with external partners.
  • Native or near-native English. You write clearly, present with confidence, and negotiate comfortably with US partners.

Nice to have

  • Higher education experience. Online degrees, university partnerships, OPM, accreditation, or admissions, ideally in the US market.
  • Go-to-market for education. Background in product marketing or launching education products.
  • AI and ML knowledge. Enough grounding in the AI and ML landscape, ideally hands-on, to discuss the program credibly with faculty and students.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote, full-time collaboration.
  • International team. Colleagues across the US, Latin America, and Europe.
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem. This is a role for someone who has both managed products and designed them hands-on, owning product outcomes while personally doing the research and design work. This role drives the strategy that makes Sophia Learning’s platform user-centric, scalable, intelligent, and future-ready - centralizing customer data insights, enabling predictive analytics and experimentation, and applying artificial intelligence to enhance every aspect of the learner and partner experience.

Operating at the intersection of product strategy, user experience design, and AI innovation, this leader partners with senior executives, business partners, data scientists, and engineering leaders to deeply understand user behavior and identify opportunities to move Sophia towards our future vision for learning, including implementing an agentic-enabled design system and driving the strategic application of AI across all Sophia Learning products.

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning operates as a senior leader in the product organization, influencing company-wide priorities, mentoring product peers, and aligning investments to Sophia Learning’s mission of expanding opportunity and access through education. Beyond design execution, this role owns the voice of the customer and carries accountability for experience direction: building a continuous discovery practice that shapes which problems Sophia should solve and securing executive alignment through research evidence and trade-off analysis rather than consensus.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the multi-year product strategy for the user experience of Sophia’s online learning platform, ensuring alignment with business goals and executive priorities.
  • Establish and lead a continuous discovery and user research practice (interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping) that keeps Sophia close to its learners and institutional partners, synthesizing research, behavioral data, and market signals into problem statements, personas, and prioritized opportunities.
  • Guide the organization’s AI product vision and roadmap, collaborating with engineering, data science, and product leaders to align AI initiatives across multiple product areas.
  • Lead initiatives to embed machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI models into core Sophia Learning applications, driving automation and intelligent user experiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership, translating research insights and technical opportunities into business value and influencing portfolio-level decisions.
  • Establish design best practices and design review mechanisms that ensure consistent quality across the product.
  • Own end-to-end experiences across learner, partner, and administrative workflows, translating user needs and business goals into flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs and partnering with Engineering to ensure design intent reaches production with a high bar for quality and accessibility (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA).
  • Oversee the design and delivery of a scalable, governed design system that centralizes design assets, establishing design standards, documentation, and accessibility models that make the system AI-ready for agentic development.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/Analytics, and AI teams to implement UX success metrics and an experimentation framework that supports predictive analytics, personalization, and automation.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, elevating design thinking, product strategy, and customer-centric thinking across the team, including research methods and rapid prototyping with the design system and agentic development tools.
  • Represent Sophia Learning as an industry thought leader, contributing to the company’s credibility in AI for online learning, ethical AI, and data-driven learning experiences.

Job Skills:

  • Deep expertise in product design, user research, AI-driven product strategy, and large-scale platform systems.
  • Proven ability to lead research and translate customer insight into product direction, influencing what gets built, not only how it looks.
  • Equally comfortable defining requirements, prioritizing a backlog, and owning delivery as personally producing wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and prototypes.
  • Strong understanding of modern design and prototyping tools, component-based design systems, accessibility standards, and component lifecycle management, including structuring design systems for agentic development and AI coding tools.
  • Proven ability to bridge technical depth and executive influence, communicating complex technical concepts with clarity and confidence, and turning research findings into decisions.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional AI initiatives that span design, data engineering, product, and data science.
  • Skilled in defining AI governance frameworks and human-centered AI design principles, ensuring responsible, compliant use of data and models.
  • Exceptional leadership and mentoring skills; able to develop product talent and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical and design excellence.
  • Thought leadership in AI design strategy, personalization, and data ethics, with a focus on driving measurable impact for customers.

Work Experience:

  • 6+ years of product design and/or product management experience in SaaS, data platform, or AI-driven product environments, including hands-on design work (user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI) and ownership of product outcomes for complex, cross-functional product areas. EdTech experience preferred.

  • Working familiarity with cloud data ecosystems (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern data and AI tools, sufficient to partner credibly with data science and engineering teams on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Hands-on depth is welcome but not required. Experience with behavioral analytics and experimentation tools preferred.

raw.excerpt: Job Description:At DXC Technology, our SAP practice works with customers across the UK and Europe to deliver SAP solutions that support their most important business processes.
raw.description:
Job Description:

At DXC Technology, our SAP practice works with customers across the UK and Europe to deliver SAP solutions that support their most important business processes.


We’re looking for an experienced SAP FICO Functional Consultant to join our team and play a key role in helping customers get the most from their SAP Finance solutions. We’re committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and succeed, with support and reasonable adjustments available throughout the hiring process.


This is a varied role where you’ll work closely with customers, business users and colleagues across the wider SAP practice. You’ll be involved in understanding business needs, shaping solutions, configuring SAP and supporting customers throughout the project lifecycle.


You’ll need to be comfortable working directly with clients and taking ownership of your area of SAP Finance. We’re particularly interested in people who have experience across the full project lifecycle, from proposal response, solutioning and planning through to mobilisation, implementation and delivery.

Experience of SAP S/4HANA, including S/4HANA migration programmes, would be particularly valuable.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you’ll be doing

You’ll work closely with customers and project teams to understand their business processes and translate their requirements into practical SAP solutions.

Your role will include:

  • Gathering and analysing business requirements and understanding how SAP ECC and S/4HANA can support the customer's Finance processes.
  • Working directly with clients to understand their requirements, challenge where appropriate, and validate proposed solutions.
  • Contributing to the wider SAP solution design, working collaboratively with colleagues across the DXC SAP practice and customer teams to keep projects moving forward. Be prepared to lead on engagements that incorporate a broader functional/technical scope requiring cross team collaboration.
  • Configuring SAP FICO in line with agreed business requirements and translating those requirements into clear functional design specifications.
  • Understanding the impact of SAP changes on business processes, reporting and user interfaces, and recommending improvements where appropriate.
  • Supporting customers with business process changes and improvement initiatives.
  • Providing ongoing SAP functional support and working with technical teams and customers to investigate and resolve functional issues.
  • Contributing to project activities across the full lifecycle, including proposal responses, solutioning, planning, mobilisation and implementation.
  • Creating and maintaining clear project and functional documentation, including Requirements Traceability Matrices, Business Process Blueprints, Configuration Documentation, Functional Specifications, Test Scripts and Training Guides.
  • Sharing your SAP Finance knowledge with colleagues and being open to developing your skills in new areas where customer demand requires it.
  • Helping to strengthen the wider DXC SAP practice by bringing your experience, ideas and knowledge to new customer opportunities and solutions.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who combines strong SAP FICO knowledge with a genuine interest in understanding how businesses operate and helping customers solve their challenges.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Strong experience working with SAP Finance/FICO in a consulting or client-facing environment.
  • Experience gathering and analysing business requirements and translating them into SAP solutions.
  • Experience of SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA, with S/4HANA experience particularly valuable.
  • Experience supporting or contributing to S/4HANA migration programmes within your functional area.
  • Experience working across the full SAP project lifecycle, from proposal response and solutioning through to planning, mobilisation, implementation and delivery.
  • Experience managing and building relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting business process change and improvement initiatives.
  • Strong functional configuration and documentation skills.
  • The confidence to work collaboratively within a project team while also taking ownership of your own area of responsibility including hands on.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical and business matters clearly to different audiences.
  • A practical, analytical approach to problem solving and the ability to understand the wider business impact of an SAP issue or change.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and remain effective in a fast-paced project environment.

We’re also looking for people who are self-motivated, collaborative and willing to learn. As our customers' needs evolve, you may have opportunities to work in new areas of SAP Finance and develop your skills while helping us expand the capabilities of our SAP practice.


Working at DXC

This is a home-based, virtual-first role, giving you the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected with your customers and colleagues. There may be occasional travel for customer meetings or project requirements, but this is expected to be infrequent.


At DXC, you’ll be part of an experienced SAP community where you can share knowledge, learn from colleagues and work on a range of customer projects. We value people who are curious, collaborative and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex business challenges.


You’ll also have access to a competitive salary and flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


If you’re passionate about SAP Finance, enjoy working with customers and like being part of a collaborative team, we’d be really interested in hearing from you.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. raw.description:
This is a remote position.

REMOTE / WORK FROM HOME POSITION
Before applying, please note:
The entire application process must be completed in English. Fluent written and spoken English is required and will be evaluated.
Applicants must be independent freelancers, not represented by another agency.
WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD
We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry.
We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.

Job Overview / Purpose Statement

The Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains data infrastructure to support digital marketing strategies. Working closely with analysts, CSMs, and cross-functional teams, this role ensures data is collected, stored, and processed efficiently and accurately. It also supports the growth of the Data Management & Visualization team by developing scalable pipelines, ensuring quality, and preparing data for dashboards and reporting.
Responsibilities & Duties
Database Management:
  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, clean, and transform data from various sources (e.g., CRM systems, Google Analytics, Ad platforms, inventory feeds).
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to support business needs.
  • Optimize data storage solutions using databases, data warehouses, and cloud services (e.g., Google Cloud).
  • Monitor and ensure the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of database data.
  • Perform database performance optimization and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
ETL Processes:
  • Understand the data flow for the client data to implement new extraction techniques.
  • Develop and maintain ETL workflows to collect, transform, and load data into appropriate storage solutions.
  • Automate data pipelines to ensure timely and efficient data processing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and implement solutions.
Data Quality Assurance:
  • Conduct regular data audits to identify and resolve data inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Implement and monitor processes to maintain high data quality standards.
  • Collaboration Impact: Positive feedback from team members and stakeholders on data readiness.
Support for Visualization:
  • Prepare data for use in dashboards and visualizations.
  • Collaborate with the analytics to ensure data is structured and available for reporting needs.
Collaboration:
  • Work closely with senior team members and leadership to align data processes with business goals.
  • Provide support for data-related issues raised by internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve processes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications
Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Technical Skills:
  • Basic knowledge of database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiarity with ETL tools and processes (e.g., Apache Airflow, Talend, or custom Python scripts).
  • Understanding data formats (e.g., JSON, CSV, XML) and APIs.
  • Proficiency in a programming language such as Python or SQL.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.
Soft Skills:
  • An analytical mindset and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Experience & Competencies
  • Must be proficient in English (written and verbal)
  • Strong problem-solving, quantitative, and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and delegation skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML integration basics.
  • Ability to work independently and align with a remote team in CST hours

OUR HIRING PROCESS

1. Application Review
2. Initial Interview
3. Skills Assessment
4. Final Interview

Benefits

How We Work
  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.
  • Be helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.

The Perks!
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
  • Parental Leave: We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
  • Room to Grow: We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.
  • Professional Development: Get access to training in digital marketing, advertising, and leadership to sharpen your skills and advance your career.
  • Quarterly Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your performance and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Paid Referral Program: Earn rewards for referring great talent to join our team!
  • ​Health & Fitness Reimbursement (upon tenure): Get support for health insurance or a gym membership—because your well-being matters.

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

From day one, you will be a valued part of our development team, trusted to work on projects that directly impact our products while gaining deep technical knowledge in full lifecycle product development. You will report to Senior Engineers on your team and dream up and code new features that can be shipped straight into our products.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Programming Foundation: Proficiency in Java, Python, C, C++, or other object-oriented programming languages through coursework or personal projects

  • Technical Fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their practical applications in problem-solving

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Software Engineering Experience: Demonstrated skills through previous internships, work experience, personal projects, open-source contributions, or technical publications

  • AI/ML Interest: Exposure to artificial intelligence concepts, machine learning frameworks, or emerging AI technologies (MCP, agentic AI) through coursework, projects, or self-learning

Mandatory Requirement:

  • 2028 graduate

  • 6+ CGPA (or equivalent)

  • No current/active backlogs

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

raw.title: Configuration & Release Manager (Senior)
raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Configuration & Release Manager to own configuration baselines, change records, CMDB reconciliation, release planning, and configuration reporting for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Configuration & Release Manager to own configuration baselines, change records, CMDB reconciliation, release planning, and configuration reporting for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior role ensures that application components, interfaces, infrastructure dependencies, documentation, and release artifacts are accurately identified, versioned, controlled, approved, and traceable.

The Configuration & Release Manager analyzes release impacts and maintains source and version descriptions, known-defect lists, bills of materials, build and deployment documentation, release packages, and configuration summaries. The position coordinates approvals, release readiness, implementation, validation, and operational handover across Government stakeholders, software teams, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, and operations.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Configuration & Release Manager will:

  • Establish, maintain, and govern configuration-management and release-management processes for the ENLIST software portfolio.
  • Define and maintain approved configuration baselines for applications, services, interfaces, infrastructure components, documentation, and supporting artifacts.
  • Identify configuration items and maintain accurate version, ownership, relationship, dependency, and status information.
  • Maintain configuration records and reconcile approved configuration items with the configuration management database (CMDB).
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies among source repositories, deployment environments, release records, inventories, and CMDB data.
  • Prepare configuration summaries and provide accurate baseline status for program reporting, audits, release reviews, and operational support.
  • Maintain change records and ensure approved changes are traceable from request and authorization through implementation and validation.
  • Coordinate configuration-control and change-control activities with Government representatives and program governance bodies.
  • Support change-control board reviews by preparing impact assessments, dependency information, implementation plans, rollback plans, and decision materials.
  • Analyze proposed releases for technical, operational, security, interface, data, training, documentation, and scheduling impacts.
  • Develop and maintain integrated release plans, schedules, readiness criteria, dependencies, approval points, and implementation milestones.
  • Coordinate release activities across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, database, cloud, network, training, service management, and operations teams.
  • Maintain source and version descriptions identifying included components, changes, dependencies, limitations, and installation considerations.
  • Prepare and maintain known-defect lists, including workarounds, affected capabilities, severity, disposition, and planned corrections.
  • Develop and maintain bills of materials identifying application components, libraries, dependencies, packages, and related release content.
  • Coordinate software bills of materials when required by program cybersecurity or software supply-chain processes.
  • Maintain build instructions, installation procedures, deployment instructions, configuration guidance, validation steps, and rollback procedures.
  • Assemble complete release packages containing approved software, scripts, configurations, documentation, test results, security evidence, and authorization records.
  • Verify that release artifacts are complete, versioned, approved, reproducible, and traceable to the correct source and baseline.
  • Coordinate release-readiness reviews and confirm satisfaction of testing, cybersecurity, documentation, training, operational, and approval criteria.
  • Coordinate release approvals with authorized Government and program stakeholders.
  • Support deployment scheduling, implementation coordination, status communication, issue escalation, and post-deployment validation.
  • Coordinate rollback or recovery activities when release acceptance criteria are not met.
  • Manage operational handover and ensure support teams receive required procedures, configuration information, known issues, contacts, and troubleshooting guidance.
  • Confirm that implemented releases and resulting configuration changes are accurately reflected in the CMDB and supporting records.
  • Track release metrics, configuration discrepancies, unauthorized changes, failed changes, rollback activity, known defects, and improvement actions.
  • Support audits, assessments, inspections, and reviews by producing traceable configuration and release evidence.
  • Participate in sprint planning, release planning, demonstrations, retrospectives, and program-governance activities.
  • Promote continuous improvement of configuration control, release quality, CMDB accuracy, documentation, and operational transition.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing configuration analysis.
  • Experience establishing, maintaining, or controlling configuration baselines.
  • Experience maintaining or reconciling configuration data in a CMDB.
  • Experience planning and coordinating software or technology releases.
  • Experience preparing and maintaining technical documentation.
  • Experience managing change records, configuration items, versions, dependencies, or release artifacts.
  • Ability to analyze release impacts across applications, interfaces, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, training, and operations.
  • Ability to maintain source and version descriptions, known-defect lists, bills of materials, configuration summaries, and build or deployment documentation.
  • Ability to coordinate release approvals, implementation activities, validation, rollback planning, and operational handover.
  • Ability to maintain accurate, complete, and auditable configuration and release records.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, technical documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Government representatives, developers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, service-management teams, and operations personnel.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • An ITIL certification or recognized configuration-management certification.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL 4 Practice Manager, or an advanced ITIL credential.
  • Configuration Management Process Improvement Center certification, CM2 certification, or another recognized configuration-management credential.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development, modernization, or information-technology programs.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical, regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability systems.
  • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, BMC Helix, Jira Service Management, or a comparable configuration-management platform.
  • Experience with source-code and artifact-management platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Artifactory, Nexus, or comparable solutions.
  • Experience working with automated build, CI/CD, deployment, and release-management pipelines.
  • Experience preparing bills of materials or software bills of materials.
  • Experience supporting configuration-control boards, change-advisory boards, release-readiness reviews, or formal Government approval processes.
  • Experience with baseline audits, configuration-status accounting, physical configuration audits, or functional configuration audits.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, systems-engineering, service-transition, and secure software-development practices.
  • Familiarity with DoD security requirements, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, software supply-chain controls, and release governance.
  • Experience coordinating production deployments, operational handovers, rollback activities, and post-implementation reviews.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

The Role

The Medical Editor at Avalere Health supports assigned projects and accounts by editing and proofreading materials, checking data, contributing to competitive intelligence writing, assessing copyright permissions, and completing other requested project tasks.

Working under the direction of senior team members, the Medical Editor primarily works with internal colleagues, keeping them informed of project progress, while also communicating externally with congress organizers, journals, and copyright holders. As Medical Editor you will work across multiple accounts and gain broad experience in medical editing–related tasks. Through hands-on experience with various project types, you will develop your medical editing skills, undertake more technical editing and data-checking tasks, and build your copyright knowledge as you progress in the role.

What you'll do

    • Edits and proofreads scientific and medical communications for accuracy, clarity, consistency, readability, and compliance with client, house, journal, and congress style requirements.

    • Reviews content critically, raising appropriate queries and recommending changes to improve flow, comprehensiveness, and suitability for the intended audience.

    • Applies and maintains client-specific style guidelines and editorial processes, using judgment to agree on the appropriate level of editing or proofreading for each project.

    • Performs data checking to verify that scientific information and claims are accurate, used consistently and supported by source references.

    • Assesses copyright permissions requirements and provides clear, practical guidance to project and account teams.

    • Manages assigned work across multiple projects and accounts, delivering high-quality outputs to agreed timelines and escalating issues as needed.

    • Manages time and workload effectively, communicates proactively with editorial and account teams, and contributes relably to successful project delivery.

About you

    • Degree in a scientific or related field; advanced degree advantageous (MD, PhD, PharmD, MSc, or equivalent).

    • 1 year + experience in medical or scientific editing within a healthcare consultancy or medical communications agency.

    • Working knowledge of medical style guides, such as the AMA Manual of Style, and proficiency in applying the necessary guidelines to project deliverables.

    • Knowledge of client reference and review processes, and online reference-retrieval tools.

    • Knowledge of copyright permissions and how they apply in the medical communications/pharmaceutical industry.

    • Proficiency in internet and PubMed searches, and knowledge of literature reviews and how to conduct them.

    • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; Adobe Acrobat; and the reference management software EndNote.

    • Ability to prioritise, work independently with minimal supervision, and collaborate effectively as part of a team.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

raw.description:
We’re looking for someone who lives a few steps ahead of the blockchain market.
Not just someone who knows how smart contracts work, but someone who constantly asks: What’s next? What should we support? What can we integrate? What are other wallets already doing that we should do better?
Your mission will be to continuously explore the blockchain ecosystem, identify technologies and opportunities worth pursuing, and turn them into concrete product and technical initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Continuously monitor blockchain ecosystems, emerging technologies, protocol upgrades, standards, and competitor wallets.
  • Identify promising blockchain innovations and translate them into concrete product and technical initiatives.
  • Research and define multisig architectures, cryptographic solutions, and signing mechanisms across different blockchain networks.
  • Evaluate new networks, protocols, EIPs/BIPs, smart-contract capabilities, and third-party integrations.
  • Provide technical and architectural recommendations, balancing security, feasibility, and product value.
  • Own the blockchain innovation backlog - from research and prioritization to implementation.
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to shape the blockchain roadmap and drive cross-functional initiatives.

Requirements

  • Deep understanding of blockchain architecture and applied cryptography, including digital signatures, key management, and cryptographic security principles.
  • Strong expertise in multisig architectures across different blockchain ecosystems, including MPC, threshold signatures, and smart-contract-based solutions.
  • Solid knowledge of ERC, EIP, and BIP standards, major blockchain networks, protocols, and infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience in blockchain engineering, smart-contract development, cryptography, or technical R&D.
  • Strong awareness of major and recent blockchain ecosystem developments, emerging technologies, and industry trends.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating blockchain technologies into real products.
  • Strong product mindset - ability to connect technical innovations with business opportunities and product strategy.
  • Technical leadership and ownership - ability to make architectural decisions, align stakeholders, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution.
  • Genuine passion for blockchain innovation and staying ahead of the market.

Benefits

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world, excluding Russia and Belarus, with a schedule aligned with GMT+3
  • Competitive salary in EURO/USDT
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Birthday presents

As Director Technical Product Management-Supply Planning, this role will be accountable for all aspects (planning, forecasting, production, vision and roadmap) of the end-to-end lifecycle of our Supply Planning application space while working as a People Leader for a small team and individually running impactful projects that span across Materials Digital Technology.

This role requires a player-coach capability and mindset to lead and mentor a DT team, strong execution individually on project deliverables, and an ability to closely partner with customers and key stakeholders.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Leverages deep process/domain expertise within Supply Chain, Materials, and Supply Planning while partnering with and leading Product Owners and our technical development teams. Influences key stakeholders in design and planning decisions. Drives the development of products that are targeted at a (usually) very technical audience. Combines the customer vision with technical feasibility to convert business needs into functional specifications/user stories. Works with customers/stakeholders to prioritize needs. Creates the strategic roadmap for the product. Coordinates work of several parallel teams to deliver on higher level outcomes. Responsible for transparent delivery and maximizing returns. Focuses on execution for the duration of a product release.
  • As a People Leader, serves as best practice/quality resource while driving Flight Deck fundamentals and altering how we work utilizing AI. Has awareness of latest technical developments in Supply Chain and contributes towards strategy and roadmap development, and ensure delivery of high quality solutions, on-time.
  • Uses judgment to make decisions or solve complex tasks or problems in areas of operational/product management, Supply Chain, Materials, Manufacturing and adjacent functional areas. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.
  • Acts as a resource and mentor for colleagues with less experience. Will lead large projects with risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Highly developed persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within Supply Chain Digital Technology.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 7 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 10 years of professional experience
  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience in Technical Product Management
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.

  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
  • Established project management skills.

  • Oracle Advanced Supply Chain Planning Experience

Eligibility Requirement
