raw.description:
The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem. This is a role for someone who has both managed products and designed them hands-on, owning product outcomes while personally doing the research and design work. This role drives the strategy that makes Sophia Learning’s platform user-centric, scalable, intelligent, and future-ready - centralizing customer data insights, enabling predictive analytics and experimentation, and applying artificial intelligence to enhance every aspect of the learner and partner experience.

Operating at the intersection of product strategy, user experience design, and AI innovation, this leader partners with senior executives, business partners, data scientists, and engineering leaders to deeply understand user behavior and identify opportunities to move Sophia towards our future vision for learning, including implementing an agentic-enabled design system and driving the strategic application of AI across all Sophia Learning products.

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning operates as a senior leader in the product organization, influencing company-wide priorities, mentoring product peers, and aligning investments to Sophia Learning’s mission of expanding opportunity and access through education. Beyond design execution, this role owns the voice of the customer and carries accountability for experience direction: building a continuous discovery practice that shapes which problems Sophia should solve and securing executive alignment through research evidence and trade-off analysis rather than consensus.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the multi-year product strategy for the user experience of Sophia’s online learning platform, ensuring alignment with business goals and executive priorities.
  • Establish and lead a continuous discovery and user research practice (interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping) that keeps Sophia close to its learners and institutional partners, synthesizing research, behavioral data, and market signals into problem statements, personas, and prioritized opportunities.
  • Guide the organization’s AI product vision and roadmap, collaborating with engineering, data science, and product leaders to align AI initiatives across multiple product areas.
  • Lead initiatives to embed machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI models into core Sophia Learning applications, driving automation and intelligent user experiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership, translating research insights and technical opportunities into business value and influencing portfolio-level decisions.
  • Establish design best practices and design review mechanisms that ensure consistent quality across the product.
  • Own end-to-end experiences across learner, partner, and administrative workflows, translating user needs and business goals into flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs and partnering with Engineering to ensure design intent reaches production with a high bar for quality and accessibility (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA).
  • Oversee the design and delivery of a scalable, governed design system that centralizes design assets, establishing design standards, documentation, and accessibility models that make the system AI-ready for agentic development.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/Analytics, and AI teams to implement UX success metrics and an experimentation framework that supports predictive analytics, personalization, and automation.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, elevating design thinking, product strategy, and customer-centric thinking across the team, including research methods and rapid prototyping with the design system and agentic development tools.
  • Represent Sophia Learning as an industry thought leader, contributing to the company’s credibility in AI for online learning, ethical AI, and data-driven learning experiences.

Job Skills:

  • Deep expertise in product design, user research, AI-driven product strategy, and large-scale platform systems.
  • Proven ability to lead research and translate customer insight into product direction, influencing what gets built, not only how it looks.
  • Equally comfortable defining requirements, prioritizing a backlog, and owning delivery as personally producing wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and prototypes.
  • Strong understanding of modern design and prototyping tools, component-based design systems, accessibility standards, and component lifecycle management, including structuring design systems for agentic development and AI coding tools.
  • Proven ability to bridge technical depth and executive influence, communicating complex technical concepts with clarity and confidence, and turning research findings into decisions.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional AI initiatives that span design, data engineering, product, and data science.
  • Skilled in defining AI governance frameworks and human-centered AI design principles, ensuring responsible, compliant use of data and models.
  • Exceptional leadership and mentoring skills; able to develop product talent and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical and design excellence.
  • Thought leadership in AI design strategy, personalization, and data ethics, with a focus on driving measurable impact for customers.

Work Experience:

  • 6+ years of product design and/or product management experience in SaaS, data platform, or AI-driven product environments, including hands-on design work (user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI) and ownership of product outcomes for complex, cross-functional product areas. EdTech experience preferred.
  • Proven track record leading product design initiatives, including customer-facing AI initiatives, from concept through implementation preferred.
  • Working familiarity with cloud data ecosystems (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern data and AI tools, sufficient to partner credibly with data science and engineering teams on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Hands-on depth is welcome but not required. Experience with behavioral analytics and experimentation tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating with executive stakeholders and technical leaders to deliver transformative business outcomes required.
  • Experience establishing or scaling a research or continuous discovery practice, including research that changed a roadmap decision preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Cognitive Science, Learning Science, or a related field, (Master’s preferred) or equivalent work experience.

Certificates, licenses and registrations:

  • Generative AI Solution Development (preferred)
  • Product strategy or continuous discovery coursework (e.g., Reforge, Pragmatic Institute, Continuous Discovery Habits) (preferred)
  • Accessibility certification (e.g., IAAP CPACC) (preferred)

Other:

  • Must be able to travel occasionally should a business need arise. For most roles travel would not be common. Travel may involve plane, car or metro. In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or Capella Core Faculty (5 – 10%).
  • Ability to work onsite in Corporate or Campus location (in a typical office environment) may be required based on role. If so, this would include being mobile within the office, including movement from floor-to-floor using elevators or stairs.
  • If offsite or hybrid role, must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • Faculty and Federal Work Study roles require access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including computer, privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • This role may require lifting, however reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with our ADA policies.
  • Must be able to meet critical thinking and problem solving aspects aligned to job duties, as well as effectively communicating with co-workers.
  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.
  • Able to access information using a computer.
  • Other essential functions and marginal job functions are subject to modification.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

raw.title: SAP FICO Functional Consultant
raw.excerpt: Job Description:At DXC Technology, our SAP practice works with customers across the UK and Europe to deliver SAP solutions that support their most important business processes.
raw.description:
Job Description:

At DXC Technology, our SAP practice works with customers across the UK and Europe to deliver SAP solutions that support their most important business processes.


We’re looking for an experienced SAP FICO Functional Consultant to join our team and play a key role in helping customers get the most from their SAP Finance solutions. We’re committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and succeed, with support and reasonable adjustments available throughout the hiring process.


This is a varied role where you’ll work closely with customers, business users and colleagues across the wider SAP practice. You’ll be involved in understanding business needs, shaping solutions, configuring SAP and supporting customers throughout the project lifecycle.


You’ll need to be comfortable working directly with clients and taking ownership of your area of SAP Finance. We’re particularly interested in people who have experience across the full project lifecycle, from proposal response, solutioning and planning through to mobilisation, implementation and delivery.

Experience of SAP S/4HANA, including S/4HANA migration programmes, would be particularly valuable.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you’ll be doing

You’ll work closely with customers and project teams to understand their business processes and translate their requirements into practical SAP solutions.

Your role will include:

  • Gathering and analysing business requirements and understanding how SAP ECC and S/4HANA can support the customer's Finance processes.
  • Working directly with clients to understand their requirements, challenge where appropriate, and validate proposed solutions.
  • Contributing to the wider SAP solution design, working collaboratively with colleagues across the DXC SAP practice and customer teams to keep projects moving forward. Be prepared to lead on engagements that incorporate a broader functional/technical scope requiring cross team collaboration.
  • Configuring SAP FICO in line with agreed business requirements and translating those requirements into clear functional design specifications.
  • Understanding the impact of SAP changes on business processes, reporting and user interfaces, and recommending improvements where appropriate.
  • Supporting customers with business process changes and improvement initiatives.
  • Providing ongoing SAP functional support and working with technical teams and customers to investigate and resolve functional issues.
  • Contributing to project activities across the full lifecycle, including proposal responses, solutioning, planning, mobilisation and implementation.
  • Creating and maintaining clear project and functional documentation, including Requirements Traceability Matrices, Business Process Blueprints, Configuration Documentation, Functional Specifications, Test Scripts and Training Guides.
  • Sharing your SAP Finance knowledge with colleagues and being open to developing your skills in new areas where customer demand requires it.
  • Helping to strengthen the wider DXC SAP practice by bringing your experience, ideas and knowledge to new customer opportunities and solutions.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who combines strong SAP FICO knowledge with a genuine interest in understanding how businesses operate and helping customers solve their challenges.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Strong experience working with SAP Finance/FICO in a consulting or client-facing environment.
  • Experience gathering and analysing business requirements and translating them into SAP solutions.
  • Experience of SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA, with S/4HANA experience particularly valuable.
  • Experience supporting or contributing to S/4HANA migration programmes within your functional area.
  • Experience working across the full SAP project lifecycle, from proposal response and solutioning through to planning, mobilisation, implementation and delivery.
  • Experience managing and building relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting business process change and improvement initiatives.
  • Strong functional configuration and documentation skills.
  • The confidence to work collaboratively within a project team while also taking ownership of your own area of responsibility including hands on.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical and business matters clearly to different audiences.
  • A practical, analytical approach to problem solving and the ability to understand the wider business impact of an SAP issue or change.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and remain effective in a fast-paced project environment.

We’re also looking for people who are self-motivated, collaborative and willing to learn. As our customers' needs evolve, you may have opportunities to work in new areas of SAP Finance and develop your skills while helping us expand the capabilities of our SAP practice.


Working at DXC

This is a home-based, virtual-first role, giving you the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected with your customers and colleagues. There may be occasional travel for customer meetings or project requirements, but this is expected to be infrequent.


At DXC, you’ll be part of an experienced SAP community where you can share knowledge, learn from colleagues and work on a range of customer projects. We value people who are curious, collaborative and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex business challenges.


You’ll also have access to a competitive salary and flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


If you’re passionate about SAP Finance, enjoy working with customers and like being part of a collaborative team, we’d be really interested in hearing from you.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

REMOTE / WORK FROM HOME POSITION
Before applying, please note:
The entire application process must be completed in English. Fluent written and spoken English is required and will be evaluated.
Applicants must be independent freelancers, not represented by another agency.
WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD
We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry.
We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.

Job Overview / Purpose Statement

The Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains data infrastructure to support digital marketing strategies. Working closely with analysts, CSMs, and cross-functional teams, this role ensures data is collected, stored, and processed efficiently and accurately. It also supports the growth of the Data Management & Visualization team by developing scalable pipelines, ensuring quality, and preparing data for dashboards and reporting.
Responsibilities & Duties
Database Management:
  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, clean, and transform data from various sources (e.g., CRM systems, Google Analytics, Ad platforms, inventory feeds).
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to support business needs.
  • Optimize data storage solutions using databases, data warehouses, and cloud services (e.g., Google Cloud).
  • Monitor and ensure the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of database data.
  • Perform database performance optimization and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
ETL Processes:
  • Understand the data flow for the client data to implement new extraction techniques.
  • Develop and maintain ETL workflows to collect, transform, and load data into appropriate storage solutions.
  • Automate data pipelines to ensure timely and efficient data processing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and implement solutions.
Data Quality Assurance:
  • Conduct regular data audits to identify and resolve data inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Implement and monitor processes to maintain high data quality standards.
  • Collaboration Impact: Positive feedback from team members and stakeholders on data readiness.
Support for Visualization:
  • Prepare data for use in dashboards and visualizations.
  • Collaborate with the analytics to ensure data is structured and available for reporting needs.
Collaboration:
  • Work closely with senior team members and leadership to align data processes with business goals.
  • Provide support for data-related issues raised by internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve processes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications
Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Technical Skills:
  • Basic knowledge of database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiarity with ETL tools and processes (e.g., Apache Airflow, Talend, or custom Python scripts).
  • Understanding data formats (e.g., JSON, CSV, XML) and APIs.
  • Proficiency in a programming language such as Python or SQL.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.
Soft Skills:
  • An analytical mindset and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Experience & Competencies
  • Must be proficient in English (written and verbal)
  • Strong problem-solving, quantitative, and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and delegation skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML integration basics.
  • Ability to work independently and align with a remote team in CST hours

OUR HIRING PROCESS

1. Application Review
2. Initial Interview
3. Skills Assessment
4. Final Interview

Benefits

How We Work
  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.
  • Be helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.

The Perks!
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
  • Parental Leave: We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
  • Room to Grow: We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.
  • Professional Development: Get access to training in digital marketing, advertising, and leadership to sharpen your skills and advance your career.
  • Quarterly Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your performance and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Paid Referral Program: Earn rewards for referring great talent to join our team!
  • ​Health & Fitness Reimbursement (upon tenure): Get support for health insurance or a gym membership—because your well-being matters.

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Configuration & Release Manager to own configuration baselines, change records, CMDB reconciliation, release planning, and configuration reporting for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior role ensures that application components, interfaces, infrastructure dependencies, documentation, and release artifacts are accurately identified, versioned, controlled, approved, and traceable.

The Configuration & Release Manager analyzes release impacts and maintains source and version descriptions, known-defect lists, bills of materials, build and deployment documentation, release packages, and configuration summaries. The position coordinates approvals, release readiness, implementation, validation, and operational handover across Government stakeholders, software teams, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, and operations.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Configuration & Release Manager will:

  • Establish, maintain, and govern configuration-management and release-management processes for the ENLIST software portfolio.
  • Define and maintain approved configuration baselines for applications, services, interfaces, infrastructure components, documentation, and supporting artifacts.
  • Identify configuration items and maintain accurate version, ownership, relationship, dependency, and status information.
  • Maintain configuration records and reconcile approved configuration items with the configuration management database (CMDB).
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies among source repositories, deployment environments, release records, inventories, and CMDB data.
  • Prepare configuration summaries and provide accurate baseline status for program reporting, audits, release reviews, and operational support.
  • Maintain change records and ensure approved changes are traceable from request and authorization through implementation and validation.
  • Coordinate configuration-control and change-control activities with Government representatives and program governance bodies.
  • Support change-control board reviews by preparing impact assessments, dependency information, implementation plans, rollback plans, and decision materials.
  • Analyze proposed releases for technical, operational, security, interface, data, training, documentation, and scheduling impacts.
  • Develop and maintain integrated release plans, schedules, readiness criteria, dependencies, approval points, and implementation milestones.
  • Coordinate release activities across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, database, cloud, network, training, service management, and operations teams.
  • Maintain source and version descriptions identifying included components, changes, dependencies, limitations, and installation considerations.
  • Prepare and maintain known-defect lists, including workarounds, affected capabilities, severity, disposition, and planned corrections.
  • Develop and maintain bills of materials identifying application components, libraries, dependencies, packages, and related release content.
  • Coordinate software bills of materials when required by program cybersecurity or software supply-chain processes.
  • Maintain build instructions, installation procedures, deployment instructions, configuration guidance, validation steps, and rollback procedures.
  • Assemble complete release packages containing approved software, scripts, configurations, documentation, test results, security evidence, and authorization records.
  • Verify that release artifacts are complete, versioned, approved, reproducible, and traceable to the correct source and baseline.
  • Coordinate release-readiness reviews and confirm satisfaction of testing, cybersecurity, documentation, training, operational, and approval criteria.
  • Coordinate release approvals with authorized Government and program stakeholders.
  • Support deployment scheduling, implementation coordination, status communication, issue escalation, and post-deployment validation.
  • Coordinate rollback or recovery activities when release acceptance criteria are not met.
  • Manage operational handover and ensure support teams receive required procedures, configuration information, known issues, contacts, and troubleshooting guidance.
  • Confirm that implemented releases and resulting configuration changes are accurately reflected in the CMDB and supporting records.
  • Track release metrics, configuration discrepancies, unauthorized changes, failed changes, rollback activity, known defects, and improvement actions.
  • Support audits, assessments, inspections, and reviews by producing traceable configuration and release evidence.
  • Participate in sprint planning, release planning, demonstrations, retrospectives, and program-governance activities.
  • Promote continuous improvement of configuration control, release quality, CMDB accuracy, documentation, and operational transition.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing configuration analysis.
  • Experience establishing, maintaining, or controlling configuration baselines.
  • Experience maintaining or reconciling configuration data in a CMDB.
  • Experience planning and coordinating software or technology releases.
  • Experience preparing and maintaining technical documentation.
  • Experience managing change records, configuration items, versions, dependencies, or release artifacts.
  • Ability to analyze release impacts across applications, interfaces, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, training, and operations.
  • Ability to maintain source and version descriptions, known-defect lists, bills of materials, configuration summaries, and build or deployment documentation.
  • Ability to coordinate release approvals, implementation activities, validation, rollback planning, and operational handover.
  • Ability to maintain accurate, complete, and auditable configuration and release records.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, technical documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Government representatives, developers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, service-management teams, and operations personnel.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • An ITIL certification or recognized configuration-management certification.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL 4 Practice Manager, or an advanced ITIL credential.
  • Configuration Management Process Improvement Center certification, CM2 certification, or another recognized configuration-management credential.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development, modernization, or information-technology programs.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical, regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability systems.
  • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, BMC Helix, Jira Service Management, or a comparable configuration-management platform.
  • Experience with source-code and artifact-management platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Artifactory, Nexus, or comparable solutions.
  • Experience working with automated build, CI/CD, deployment, and release-management pipelines.
  • Experience preparing bills of materials or software bills of materials.
  • Experience supporting configuration-control boards, change-advisory boards, release-readiness reviews, or formal Government approval processes.
  • Experience with baseline audits, configuration-status accounting, physical configuration audits, or functional configuration audits.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, systems-engineering, service-transition, and secure software-development practices.
  • Familiarity with DoD security requirements, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, software supply-chain controls, and release governance.
  • Experience coordinating production deployments, operational handovers, rollback activities, and post-implementation reviews.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

The Role

The Medical Editor at Avalere Health supports assigned projects and accounts by editing and proofreading materials, checking data, contributing to competitive intelligence writing, assessing copyright permissions, and completing other requested project tasks.

Working under the direction of senior team members, the Medical Editor primarily works with internal colleagues, keeping them informed of project progress, while also communicating externally with congress organizers, journals, and copyright holders. As Medical Editor you will work across multiple accounts and gain broad experience in medical editing–related tasks. Through hands-on experience with various project types, you will develop your medical editing skills, undertake more technical editing and data-checking tasks, and build your copyright knowledge as you progress in the role.

What you'll do

    • Edits and proofreads scientific and medical communications for accuracy, clarity, consistency, readability, and compliance with client, house, journal, and congress style requirements.

    • Reviews content critically, raising appropriate queries and recommending changes to improve flow, comprehensiveness, and suitability for the intended audience.

    • Applies and maintains client-specific style guidelines and editorial processes, using judgment to agree on the appropriate level of editing or proofreading for each project.

    • Performs data checking to verify that scientific information and claims are accurate, used consistently and supported by source references.

    • Assesses copyright permissions requirements and provides clear, practical guidance to project and account teams.

    • Manages assigned work across multiple projects and accounts, delivering high-quality outputs to agreed timelines and escalating issues as needed.

    • Manages time and workload effectively, communicates proactively with editorial and account teams, and contributes relably to successful project delivery.

About you

    • Degree in a scientific or related field; advanced degree advantageous (MD, PhD, PharmD, MSc, or equivalent).

    • 1 year + experience in medical or scientific editing within a healthcare consultancy or medical communications agency.

    • Working knowledge of medical style guides, such as the AMA Manual of Style, and proficiency in applying the necessary guidelines to project deliverables.

    • Knowledge of client reference and review processes, and online reference-retrieval tools.

    • Knowledge of copyright permissions and how they apply in the medical communications/pharmaceutical industry.

    • Proficiency in internet and PubMed searches, and knowledge of literature reviews and how to conduct them.

    • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; Adobe Acrobat; and the reference management software EndNote.

    • Ability to prioritise, work independently with minimal supervision, and collaborate effectively as part of a team.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

As Director Technical Product Management-Supply Planning, this role will be accountable for all aspects (planning, forecasting, production, vision and roadmap) of the end-to-end lifecycle of our Supply Planning application space while working as a People Leader for a small team and individually running impactful projects that span across Materials Digital Technology.

Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.

In this fully remote position, you will be responsible for receiving incoming maintenance requests, virtually assessing the situation, scheduling appropriate local vendors, and following up to ensure timely resolution.

We are looking for strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication, vendor management abilities, and high operational efficiency to manage property service workflows remotely.

Key Responsibilities

Request & Logistics Management

  • Request Handling: Receive, log, and prioritize daily tenant/occupant repair requests, service inquiries, and support tickets.
  • Virtual Problem Diagnosis: Communicate with occupants to gather clear details, photos, or videos to understand the issue and identify the right service provider needed.
  • Vendor Dispatch & Scheduling: Contact, schedule, and assign appropriate third-party vendors or local technicians to resolve issues, coordinating access with property occupants.
  • Inspection Logistics: Coordinate schedules and log appointments for property inspections between occupants, local team members, and third-party inspectors (you will schedule and track logistics, not conduct physical walk-throughs).
  • Emergency Escalation: Serve as the primary remote point of contact for urgent property issues, quickly dispatching local emergency contractors to minimize damage or risk.

Vendor & Contractor Management

  • Vendor Sourcing & Coordination: Identify, reach out to, schedule, and follow up with external contractors and service providers (e.g., plumbers, electricians, HVAC specialists, locksmiths, pest control).
  • Service Follow-up & Quality Assurance: Review vendor job reports, completion notes, and photos remotely to verify that requested work was completed satisfactorily before closing tickets.
  • Cost & Invoice Review: Request quotes, review pricing for reasonableness, track service costs, and verify vendor invoices against completed work order details.
  • Vendor Relationship Building: Maintain an organized database of reliable local service providers, contractors, and suppliers.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Customer Service, Dispatch, or Administrative Project Management.
  • Vendor Management: Proven ability to source, communicate with, schedule, and manage external vendors or service providers remotely.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong diagnostic capabilities and logical reasoning to ask the right questions, troubleshoot issues remotely, and determine practical solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills to interact professionally with occupants, property managers, and external contractors.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional capacity to multi-task, prioritize high-urgency requests, track status across multiple open work orders, and maintain clean digital logs.
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable learning and using cloud-based software, ticketing platforms, communication tools, and work order management systems.

WARNINGS:

  • NO TEMPORARY workers.
  • The working schedule is from Monday to Friday, from 8:30 am until 5:00 pm EST.
  • NO working for another company at the same time.
  • NO hiring subs to do what we hired you to do.
  • We terminate immediately due to these violations.

Citiside Properties is a property management company that manages properties for investors with portfolios of homes and/or multi-unit apartments needing off-site management.

Core Values we expect team members to remember:

  • Trust
  • Transparency
  • Go getter.

About the Role

Olive & June is seeking an FP&A Manager to support the company's financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis processes. This role is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional looking to grow their strategic finance skills within a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the FP&A Manager will help deliver financial insights that support decision-making across the business.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and financial modeling skills, experience in a startup or high-growth organization, and a desire to learn and develop as a finance leader. This individual should be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying business trends, and partnering with stakeholders to improve financial performance. Experience in consumer products, beauty, retail, or direct-to-consumer brands is preferred.

This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, building scalable processes, and contributing to the growth of an innovative and rapidly expanding business.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Assist with annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
  • Develop and maintain integrated financial models to support strategic planning and scenario analysis.
  • Monitor company performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Business Analysis & Decision Support

  • Partner closely with leaders across Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Development, Sales, and People teams.
  • Analyze business performance drivers, including revenue, gross margin, customer acquisition costs, inventory, and operating expenses.
  • Evaluate growth initiatives, product launches, retail partnerships, and pricing strategies through financial modeling and ROI analyses.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to support key business decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners.

Operational Finance

  • Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations teams to understand inventory, demand planning, purchasing, and margin trends.
  • Support forecasting and reporting for inventory, freight, manufacturing, and fulfillment costs.
  • Develop KPIs and dashboards that improve visibility into business performance.

Process Improvement

  • Help build scalable FP&A processes, reporting infrastructure, and financial systems to support continued growth.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve data accuracy and efficiency.
  • Establish best practices for financial planning and business performance management.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or related analytical roles.
  • Experience working at a startup, emerging growth company, or high-growth organization.
  • Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and business drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and financial systems expertise.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels.

Preferred

  • Experience in beauty, consumer packaged goods (CPG), consumer retail, or direct-to-consumer brands.
  • Experience supporting inventory-intensive businesses.
  • Familiarity with ERPs and Planning Tools.
  • Experience supporting fundraising activities, board reporting, or strategic growth initiatives.

What Makes You Successful

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with strong business judgment.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Naturally curious and proactive in identifying insights and opportunities.
  • Excited to roll up your sleeves and build processes in a growing organization.
  • Collaborative, positive, and energized by partnering across teams.

raw.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

For most people, health insurance happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give employees a healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them while employers get predictable costs.

It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology. We're just getting started. We look for people who use good judgment, take ownership, and care deeply about building something that matters.

Design is central to what makes Thatch stand out. We're building a brand that sets a new standard for healthcare. We're a small, collaborative team with high standards for craft, bold creative thinking, and a shared ambition to make something complex feel remarkably simple.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape Thatch's next chapter. We've built a product people love, and now we're ready to bring that same ambition to our visual identity. You'll develop creative concepts and bring them to life across web, campaigns, events, print, and more, helping define how people see and experience Thatch.

What you'll do

  • Shape and evolve Thatch's visual identity, building a distinctive, cohesive brand across every touchpoint.
  • Develop and execute creative concepts across our website, campaigns, digital content, events, print, and more.
  • Own design projects end to end, from early exploration and creative direction through production and launch.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Design to translate business goals and complex ideas into compelling creative work.
  • Present and advocate for your ideas, incorporating feedback while maintaining a high bar for craft and consistency.
  • Collaborate with external creative partners when needed, bringing fresh ideas and approaches to how we tell our story.

What we are looking for

  • 3–5 years of experience in brand, visual, or marketing design, ideally at a startup or high-growth company.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across typography, layout, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience translating a brand identity into cohesive, high-quality work across digital and physical touchpoints.
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Ability to move quickly, iterate thoughtfully, and deliver polished work.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate across teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, a sense of ownership, and the judgment to know when to challenge the brief.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

  • Motion design, animation, or video experience.
  • Ability to build and ship web experiences using HTML/CSS, Framer, or similar tools.
  • Experience using AI tools to explore ideas and improve creative workflows.
  • Experience helping a growing company evolve its brand.

What to expect

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, rigorous, and efficient. Most candidates complete it within three weeks.

  • A 30-minute conversation with a recruiter.
  • A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager.
  • A portfolio review focused on your creative process, visual craft, and brand thinking.
  • Functional interviews focused on creative collaboration, communication, and working style.
  • A final conversation with a member of our executive team.
Estimated Compensation Range
$150,000—$200,000 USD

Job Title: Associate Director, Global Commercial Trade Compliance

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Education Required:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or similar and 8 + years of progressive experience in Global Trade Compliance required.
  • Master’s degree and 6+ years of progressive experience in Trade Compliance preferably within the biotech, pharmaceutical, CRO, industry.

The Associate Director, Global Trade Compliance provides enterprise-wide strategic leadership for global trade compliance and operations. This role is accountable for designing, implementing, and overseeing an organization’s international import and export compliance programs.


Responsibilities:


Global Import & Customs Operations

  • Multi-Jurisdictional Customs Governance: Direct corporate Multi-Jurisdictional Customs Governance: Direct corporate compliance with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and parallel international customs authorities across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.
  • Global Master Data Management: Standardize and audit worldwide trade master data, ensuring accuracy in Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classifications, Country of Origin (COO), and structural customs valuation methodologies.
  • Duty Optimization Strategies: Design and execute corporate programs to capture duty savings via Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), Duty Drawback, Bonded Warehouses, and Foreign Trade Zones (FTZs).

Partner Government Agency Governance

  • Food and Drug Administration (FDA): Direct the cross-border compliance framework for commercial drug products and biologics. Ensure FDA master data is accurate and used throughout the supply chain and in parallel international equivalents across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM. Serve as the lead investigator and responder for FDA import alerts.
  • U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA): Govern the import and export of animal-derived components, biological media, cell lines, and enzymes used in biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Coordinate with the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) to secure vital import permits and veterinary health certificates and in parallel international equivalents across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.
  • Environmental Protection Agency (EPA): Direct trade compliance programs for chemical formulations and lab reagents under the Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA). Manage positive/negative TSCA certifications and in parallel international equivalents across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.
  • Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS): Command the licensing and declaration process for pharmaceutical ingredients, active elements, or research materials derived from protected animal or plant species under CITES and the Endangered Species Act (ESA) and in parallel international equivalents across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.

Risk Management & Enterprise Leadership

  • Global Audit & Corrective Action: Maintain the strategy and process for internal trade assessments, external government audits, and the submissions of PSCs, PD’s, etc.
  • Broker & Partner Network Governance: Maintain global service level agreements (SLAs), SOPs, and KPIs for international customs brokers and freight forwarders to minimize clearance delays.
  • Supply Chain Security Programs: Develop global trusted trader programs including C-TPAT, AEO (Authorized Economic Operator), and PIP.
  • Global Export Controls & Sanctions: Work within a Cross Functional team to continue the improvement of our deemed exports, controls and sanctions screenings, and dual-use program.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

5+ years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources, preferred.


Computer Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook), Advanced expertise in GTM systems, TMS architecture, and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP).

Other Qualifications: Due to global nature of company early morning or evening meeting may be required


Travel: 20%

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with American Recovery Services.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

Short Description

Demonstrate proficiency in working claim edits, denials and rejections to support revenue cycle goals with timely and accurate billing. Collaborate with other departments to alert and resolve coding issues, CDM issues and other compliance issues effecting reimbursement. Utilizes International Classification of Disease (ICD-10-CM and PCS), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) including Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) and other coding references to ensure accurate coding. Addresses NCCI, OCE, LCD and other coding edits as applicable.

3-5 years required.

High School Diploma/GED

One or more of the following: RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CIC, COC, CPC, CCA, CCC, CIRCC, CCVTC and/or any of the Core Credentials or specialty credential of AAPC or AHIMA required.

raw.description:
Overview

We are looking to build out a network of Regional Talent Scouts across key gymnastics markets. These individuals will serve as the primary voice and evaluator within their assigned region, helping Prep Gymnastics scale content, strengthen relationships, and improve the depth and accuracy of our gymnast and team coverage.
This role is designed as a win-win: it allows us to expand our national footprint while giving scouts a platform to grow their personal brand through consistent exposure and content creation.

Objective

The Regional Talent Scout Program is intended to:

  • Increase content volume and consistency across all platforms
  • Improve athlete evaluation and rankings accuracy at both regional and national levels
  • Strengthen on-the-ground relationships in key gymnastics markets
  • Create a scalable system for identifying and covering talent year-round

Role Structure

Each scout will be assigned a specific region with a strong concentration of gymnastics talent. They will be responsible for owning that region from both a content and evaluation standpoint, becoming a trusted and consistent voice within their market for both gymnasts and their teams.

Core Responsibilities

1. Talent Identification & Evaluation

  • Track and evaluate top gymnasts within assigned region
  • Maintain an active pipeline of prospects across multiple age groups
  • Contribute insight toward regional and national rankings

2. Content Creation

  • Produce consistent written content (athlete spotlights, skill coverage, event recaps, evaluations)
  • Highlight top performers, emerging prospects, and key storylines
  • Support overall platform growth through increased content output

3. Event Coverage & Market Relationships

  • Build relationships with coaches, parents, players, and program directors
  • Attend and cover local, state, and regional events when possible - Travel TBD?
  • Help identify opportunities for Prep Gymnastics events and partnerships

4. Media & Platform Integration

  • Participate in Prep Gymnastics media (Instagram Lives, TikTok Lives, podcasts, etc.)
  • Contribute to social content and real-time coverage when applicable
  • Represent both the Prep Gymnastics brand and their own personal brand

Content & Activity Expectations

To ensure consistency and scalability, the role will operate with baseline expectations:

Weekly / Non-Event Coverage

  • 3–5 written pieces per week (gymnast spotlights, team coverage, recaps, evaluations)
  • Ongoing athlete tracking and note-taking within assigned region
  • Regular social contributions (observations, articles, clips, engagement or gymnast callouts)
  • Active communication with the internal team (Slack, planning, coordination, etc.)

Event Coverage Expectations

During events, scouts are expected to operate at a higher content volume to maximize exposure and real-time coverage:

  • Share 10 gymnast spotlights per day
  • Identify 15–25 top performers throughout the event on all-around and all four events
  • Produce 5 written articles post-event based on top performers and key takeaways
  • Contribute to real-time storytelling, notes, and observations during meets

Why This Matters

This program is a key step in building a more scalable and credible national platform. By establishing dedicated regional coverage, we are able to:

  • Expand content without sacrificing quality
  • Develop deeper, more informed athlete evaluations

Description

The Senior Statistical Programmer will lead single and/or multiple clinical trials and be responsible for the development, maintenance, and validation of annotated Case Report Forms (aCRFs) as well as of specifications and statistical programming of Standard Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets (or derived datasets, as applicable), Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), and submission packages required for various purposes including, but not limited to, Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) data review meetings, Interim Analyses (IAs), and Clinical Study Reports (CSR). The Senior Statistical Programmer will also review and provide input into Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), TLF Shells, and various Data Management (DM) documents (e.g., electronic Case Report Forms [eCRFs], edit checks, etc.), support DM with data cleaning activities, use global SAS macros and participate to internal initiatives to increase efficiency of the statistical programming of SDTMs, ADaMs, derived datasets, and TFLs, and use Pinnacle 21 to validate SDTMs, ADaMs, and define.XMLs.

The Senior Statistical Programmer will work collaboratively within Biostatistical study teams and across departments to produce deliverables of the highest quality possible, within agreed timelines and budget, and in conformance with applicable International Council for Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, Pharmaceutical Industry standards and guidelines, Regulatory Authority requirements and guidelines, and Innovaderm’ standard operating procedures (SOPs) and processes.

More specifically, the Senior Statistical Programmer must:

  • Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.
  • Act as a Lead Statistical Programmer on multiple single studies.
  • Review the statistical programming scope of work and budget at initiation of clinical trials and identify tasks that are out of scope.
  • Review and provide input into various DM documents (e.g., eCRF, edit checks, etc.), SAPs, and TLF Shells.
  • Support DM with data cleaning activities by programming, reporting, reviewing, and closing statistical data issues in collaboration with other Statistical Programmers and Lead Biostatistician.
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) aCRFs according to protocol, eCRF, and Innovaderm and/or Sponsor' standards and interpretation of Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) SDTM Implementation Guideline (IG) and Controlled Terminology (CT).
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) specifications and Primary or QC statistical programming (as applicable) of SDTMs, ADaMs (or derived datasets, as applicable), and TLFs based on protocol, aCRF, SAP, TLF Shells, Innovaderm and/or Sponsor's standards and interpretation of CDISC SDTM IG, ADaM IG, and CT and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).

Overview

Unified Women's Healthcare's Virtual Clinic offers nutrition and lifestyle care to women from reproduction to menopause.

Unified Women’s Healthcare (UWH) Virtual Clinic is a health provider that specializes in menopause and sexual health, nutrition and lifestyle, and weight management for women. The Virtual Clinic together with UWH affiliated practices have the unique opportunity to serve a woman’s healthcare needs – both virtually and in-person – throughout her life and hormone journey. If you’re driven by pioneering new approaches in health and wellness using technology and a unique integrated care model working closely with physicians, then the UWH Virtual Clinic culture may be for you.

In collaboration with OB/GYN physicians Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) play an integral role in supporting women’s health across the lifespan accounting for the natural hormone changes and subsequent impact on metabolic health and risk of chronic disease. In this role you will provide women with the best healthcare in the world through virtual nutrition and lifestyle services to address fertility relational nutrition (pre-conception care, IVF/IUI support and related reproductive health conditions), hormone and health concerns including weight (with and without weight loss medications), PCOS, fertility, pre-diabetes, cardiometabolic health, peri and post menopause. This takes an individual who is self-motivated, enthusiastic about clinical care, and ready to join a team of RDNs committed to improving women’s health. Services are provided through 1:1 telehealth sessions and chat/SMS service.

We're Hiring Great Talent! Unified Women’s Healthcare is always looking for talented Registered Dietician Nutritionists! Learn more about our organization and the exciting career paths we offer—let's chat!

We will be hiring part time RDNs.


Responsibilities

  • Delivery of 1:1 digital health service with customized patient plans and supportive accountability based on a patient’s personal goals, medical intake, clinical assessment, and prior encounters with other medical providers and clinicians.
  • Patient-related documentation and care coordination responsibilities
  • Attend team meetings, CEU opportunities, and training sessions
  • Potential for weekend and evening hours to meet patient needs

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Minimum of bachelor's degree in a health-related field
  • Current RDN credential required
  • Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist preferred
  • Active state licensure in at least one of the following states: NC, FL, TX, NY
  • Minimum of two years of nutrition coaching/counseling experience
  • Proven experience in motivational interviewing and behavior change skills
  • Experience with fertility relational nutrition (pre-conception care, IVF/IUI support and related reproductive health conditions preferred
  • Professional experience supporting female hormone transitions across the lifespan and addressing concerns including weight (with and without weight loss medications), PMOS, peri and post menopause, pre-diabetes, and cardiometabolic health
  • Proven experience using technology in a telehealth environment, including utilization of an EMR (Athena ideal), Microsoft 365 and remote based communication systems (i.e. Zoom, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Meetings)
  • Proven experience working independently, efficiently, and collaboratively in a remote team environment that spans clinicians, dietitians, clinical operations, and technology experts.
  • Proven agility to thrive in a culture of learning, change, and uncharted opportunities to advance women’s health.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills
  • Experience and comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Requirements

  • Commitment 90-120 days prior to official start day to allow for insurance credentialing
  • Participation in two-week training provided as part of onboarding
  • Use HIPPA compliant EMR to deliver care and produce documentation post appointment including key topics discussed, supportive and actionable strategies, and relevant educational resources
  • Refer, as necessary, to other clinicians when warranted.
  • Collaborate clinically with interdisciplinary health team including, but not limited to, other dietitians, medical doctors, naturopathic doctors, and patient care team around patient goals and relevant medical history
  • Maintain RDN state license as required
  • Maintain consistent and reliable internet and Wi-Fi access through a private, quiet, and connected workspace.

Benefits:

  • Advancing women’s healthcare. Women’s healthcare has advanced in recent years and yet remains an opportunity to make an even great impact. Join an organization that is 100% dedicated to improving the quality of life for women through evidence-based, highly accessible virtual care.
  • Fast-paced environment. An environment that is focused on disrupting the status quo and challenging conventional professional norms.
  • Flexible schedule and remote work environment. We trust our team to make the right decisions for the business, and we also recognize that means taking time to take care of yourself.

Why Join Unified Women’s Health Virtual Clinic?

A New Category in Healthcare: UWH Virtual Clinic is improving access for high quality nutrition and lifestyle care across the female hormone continuum. UWH Virtual Clinic is in a unique position to deliver virtual health care that is connected to a network of OB/GYN and fertility clinics throughout the United States. Together, this work will create the first virtual + in-person care network that is 100% dedicated to improving the lives of women across their reproductive journeys.

Our Work Truly Matters: Unified Women’s Healthcare is made up of 900+ OB/GYN care centers and 36 fertility clinics. The Virtual Clinic has the potential to extend this reach in ways that only virtual care can deliver.

Make an Impact: the network of UWH Virtual Clinic OB/GYN doctors and Registered Dietitian Nutritionists have a patient NPS of 95 and 89% of patients report symptom improvement after their Virtual Clinic treatment.

Focus on People: Unified Women’s Healthcare was rated one of the Best Places to Work in the Global Best Practices study for five years in a row. Being part of a multi-care enterprise that spans fertility, maternity, menopause, and nutrition/lifestyle care, team members have opportunities for cross category development and leadership growth.

Diversity and Inclusion: We believe that personal and professional diversity is the key to innovation. We hire based solely on your strengths and qualifications, and the way in which those strengths can directly contribute to your success in your new position.

raw.description:
Meaningful work. Rewarding career.

Make an impact providing expert financial advice with heart. Thrivent is a different kind of financial services firm, one that puts generosity at the center of saving and investing. Here, you’ll make an impact in the lives of the people you serve, helping them build, grow and protect financial well-being through purpose-based advice, investments, insurance, banking and generosity.

At Thrivent, you’ll receive the support, stability and opportunity of a Fortune 500 leader. We offer up to 14 weeks of paid training and coaching as you obtain your state insurance licenses (life, health & variable contracts), Series 7 and 66 registrations, and complete Thrivent’s comprehensive advisor onboarding program. After onboarding, you’ll have control over the income you earn, as you’ll be paid through commissions and incentives based on your success.

As a Thrivent Financial advisor, you will:

  • Build a financial practice guiding Christians on their journeys to financial clarity, empowering lives of service and faith.
  • Provide personal, actionable and achievable advice and connect clients to Thrivent products and programs.
  • Develop and maintain genuine, long-term relationships throughout generations based on trust and understanding, with the ability to serve clients in your chosen community.
  • Make client appointments by leveraging your network and Thrivent’s reputation, delivering award-winning financial workshops and marketing your practice.
  • Have the flexibility to control your schedule, allowing for work-life balance.
  • Find a collaborative culture with colleagues who want you to be successful and are willing to help you do so.
  • Get the support of specialists from every facet of the organization—such as business development, marketing, technology, engagement, and experienced advisors—as you build your business.

Desired Characteristics

Our culture and our people are special. We’re looking for people who are – or want to become – part of the communities where clients live, work and worship. Whether you’re a seasoned financial professional or looking for a career change, you could be a successful Thrivent Financial advisor if you’re:

  • Self-disciplined, independent and driven to succeed.
  • Motivated by helping others and seeing them achieve their goals.
  • A natural coach or guide with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Passionate about living a life of generosity by serving others, not just selling products.

Successful Thrivent financial advisors have come from a variety of career backgrounds, including outside sales, business management, education, ministry, hospitality, military and more. Skills acquired in these fields transition well into the financial advisor role.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Military veterans are encouraged to apply.
  • Attainment of FINRA SIE, life and health licenses (licensed role only) before contracting.
  • Satisfactory background check, fingerprinting and securities registration and/or insurance licensing verification, if applicable.

Compensation and Benefits
You’ll get all the benefits of a Fortune 500 organization and more. Here, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited earning potential through biweekly base commissions, bonus opportunities and incentive pay structures, recurring revenue streams, and dedicated planning fees for those who qualify.
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability and accidental death and dismemberment insurance.
  • Pension, 401(k) and retiree medical plans.
  • Ongoing support, training and opportunity for professional growth as you build your business.
  • Well-being programs to help you manage your physical, emotional and financial health.
  • Gift matching program to double your contributions to eligible nonprofit organizations and volunteer programs that support your efforts to make a difference.
  • Membership programs that help you connect with your clients and engage Christians to make a real impact in your community.

About Thrivent
Thrivent is a diversified financial services organization that, with its subsidiary and affiliate companies, serves more than 2.4 million clients, offering advice, insurance, investments, banking and generosity products and programs. For more than 100 years, Thrivent has been helping Christians build their financial futures and live more generous lives. Today, Thrivent is a not-for-profit, membership-owned Fortune 500 company with $179 billion in assets under management/advisement (as of 12/31/23). Thrivent carries ratings from independent rating agencies which demonstrate the strength and stability of the organization, including an A++ rating from AM Best; an Aa2 rating from Moody's Investors Service; and an AA+ rating from S&P Global Ratings. Ratings are based on Thrivent's financial strength and claims-paying ability, but do not apply to investment product performance.

This policy applies to all employees and job applicants.

To learn more about the privacy of your information, visit ourworkforce privacy policy at thrivent.com/privacy.
