UPchieve is a nonprofit that provides free, 24/7 online tutoring and college counseling to low-income middle school and high school students. Its mission is to democratize access to academic support so that all students have an equal opportunity to finish high school, attend college, and achieve upward mobility. As an Academic Coach, you will support students remotely through UPchieve’s online platform in a range of subjects, including math (pre-algebra through calculus), the sciences (biology, chemistry, and physics), reading and writing, English, U.S. history and social studies, and college prep (SAT/ACT and college essay review). Because students request help around the clock, shifts are flexible and scheduled around your availability, with a commitment of roughly 5–10 hours per week. The role is fully remote, and we provide training and feedback to help you get started.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Tutor students one-on-one through UPchieve’s virtual classroom, which pairs a single student with a single coach and provides a text-based chat and a shared whiteboard.
  • Get certified in three or more UPchieve subjects and provide academic support in those subjects (subjects span math, science, reading and writing, English, social studies and history, and college prep).
  • Complete UPchieve’s tutor training and apply feedback to provide encouraging, student-centered support — no prior tutoring experience required.
  • Strictly adheres to Liberty University policies, representing the University in an exemplary manner.
  • Works effectively as a team member, embracing and fostering LU’s Christian model and Mission – Training Champions for Christ.

Additional information may be found here


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None

QUALIFICATIONS AND CREDENTIALS

Minimum Qualifications

  • No tutoring experience required.
  • Enrolled in a degree-seeking program at Liberty University.
  • Have Federal Work Study eligibility.
  • Have 5 to 10 hours of work availability per week.
  • Must pass various background checks, including, but not limited to, a check at the time of initial employment and subsequent checks on behalf of the Federal Work Study Community ServiceProject site as well as Liberty University. Failure to pass a background check will result in immediate termination.
  • Individual must not be in default on any federal student or parent loan.
  • Individual must not be convicted of, or pled nolo contendere or guilty to, a crime involving the acquisition, use, or expenditure of federal, state, or local government funds, -or- be administratively or judicially determined to have committed fraud or any other material violation of law involving federal, state, or local government funds (CFR 668.14(b)(18)(i)).

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least a second-year student at Liberty University preferred.
  • Must be in good standing (no reprimands or suspensions).
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

ABILITIES AND COMPETENCIES ESSENTIAL TO THE FUNCTION OF THE JOB

Communication and Comprehension

  • Ability to adhere to federal, state, and institutional policy and compliance requirements including confidentiality and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing to convey clear, well articulated information.
  • Ability to understand, speak, and write English in order to convey messages and correspond in an articulate and professional manner.
  • Possess public communication skills that allow professional representation of tutoring material, Upchieve Tutoring, and Liberty University.
  • Ability to learn technology quickly.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, follow written instructions, and take initiative when needed.
  • Strong sense of self-discipline and good time management skills.

Problem Solving

  • Intuitively able to reason, analyze information and events, and apply judgment in order to solve problems of both a routine and complex nature.

Physical and Sensory Abilities

  • Regularly required to sit to perform tutoring responsibilities or type on a keyboard.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Work Environment

Virtual tutors are remote workers. The work environment must include a computer with a strong internet connection.

Driving Requirements

If the employee is required to travel in performing the duties and responsibilities of the position, the use of one’s personal vehicle (or LU vehicles) may be required for travel. Proof of a valid driver’s license, an acceptable DMV record, LU Driving Approval, and liability insurance is required when driving in the performance of the employee’s position.

Time Type

Part time

Location

Remote Location

Starting at $12.77


Student employees are paid at least the current Virginia minimum wage per hour. Pay may vary by position and department based on job responsibilities, required skills, available funding, and market conditions.

raw.description:
We’re a remote, product-focused startup building AI- and algorithm-driven systems, and we’re looking for a strong Backend Django Engineer who loves clean data models, well-designed APIs, and clever algorithms.

You’ll own core backend features end-to-end: from modeling the data to implementing the logic and exposing it through fast, reliable services that ship to users quickly, working with a small distributed team across several countries.

💰 $100 bonus: After successfully completing the assessment. To receive the assessment,
please submit your resume to this job application. If your resume is approved, you'll receive the

assessment afterwards.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement backend servicesand APIs using Python+ Django (and DRF or similar).

  • Model and evolve our domain in the database with clean, well-structured schemas and relationships.

  • Implement algorithmic/AI logicin the backend (e.g., scoring, ranking, routing, decision rules).

  • Write pragmatic, production-ready code that’s easy to reason about and iterate on.

  • Optimize for correctness and performance: efficient queries, smart indexing, and lean responses.

  • Work with the team to turn product ideas into concrete technical designs and endpoints.

  • Help shape how we build things: patterns, conventions, and how we ship and iterate as we grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building backend applications with Python + Django.

  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling and SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

  • Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similarframeworks).

  • Experience working onnon-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows,scoring rules, optimization logic).

  • Good instincts aroundperformance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obviouspitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

  • Astartup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

  • Ability to workindependently in a remote environment and communicate clearly.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in startups, side projects, or hackathons where you’ve had to ship scrappy solutions fast.

  • Background inalgorithms, optimization, or data-heavy systems.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in production.

  • Familiarity with Redis (caching, queues) and PostgreSQL at some scale.

  • Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or serverless on GCP.

This role is a central piece of our backend roadmap, and we’re aiming to fill it quickly once we meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now.
Send us your resume to start the assessment process (and get a chance at the $100 bonus).

raw.description:
Na Atlas, temos pessoas apaixonadas, curiosas, questionadoras e ousadas, que buscam soluções de impacto para acelerar o nosso crescimento. Aqui, unimos tecnologia, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento, respeito e diversidade para construir relações significativas e duradouras.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos diante de desafios e que desejem contribuir para a construção de um mundo melhor.

Temos um compromisso firme com a inclusão, a diversidade e o pertencimento. Não toleramos qualquer tipo de preconceito, porque acreditamos que inovação e transformação só florescem em ambientes de trabalho diversos e seguros.

Reforçamos que nossas vagas são especialmente destinadas a pessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e todas as demais representações da diversidade. Junte-se a nós e seja parte dessa transformação!

Descrição da vaga:

Como Customer Success Associate você fará parte do time de CS gestão de carteira, equipe responsável por garantir que nossos clientes extraiam o maior valor possível de nossos produtos e atinjam os resultados esperados. Em outras palavras, o objetivo do time é garantir o engajamento de uso, a retenção dos atuais clientes e aumento de receita por meio de oportunidades de expansão na base.

O que você vai fazer no seu dia dia:

  • Ser proativo com a sua carteira de clientes e prestar um atendimento consultivo, respeitando os prazos estabelecidos;
  • Conduzir o onboarding do cliente na(s) ferramentas(s) Atlas;
  • Realizar treinamentos de forma dinâmica, e até mesmo propor reciclagens de treinamentos aos clientes;
  • Realizar Reuniões Periódicas de Sucesso com os clientes da carteira;
  • Controle de métricas e garantir o engajamento dos clientes da carteira;
  • Atuar em UpSell com os clientes para gerar novas oportunidades;
  • Executar planos de ação para fomentar o uso integral da plataforma, de acordo com o funcionamento do negócio de cada cliente;
  • Analisar, organizar relatórios e apresentar resultados aos clientes;
  • Identificar possíveis riscos de churn e tomar medidas preventivas para mitigá-los;
  • Manter registros precisos de interações com os clientes e atualizar os sistemas de CRM com as informações relevantes;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas, como vendas e desenvolvimento de produtos, para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional;
  • Se tornar especialista no produto Atlas Governance;
  • Ter o desejo em fazer o sucesso do seu cliente o seu sucesso!

O que estamos buscando na pessoas que vai fazer parte do time:

  • Nível básico de Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado;
  • Boa habilidade de comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de negociação.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente;
  • Inglês será um diferencial.

raw.description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que já impactou mais de 2,5 milhões de pessoas por meio da nossa plataforma Queima Diária e do Augym, nosso estúdio digital especializado para o público 55+.

Nosso propósito é ajudar as pessoas a criarem a rotina possível que transforma a vida. E é esse movimento que guia tudo por aqui.

Por trás das nossas soluções, tem um time que acredita no que faz e constrói junto, todos os dias. Nossa cultura tem foco total nos resultados que podemos alcançar juntos, e os Queimers trabalham com muita responsabilidade, simplicidade e pertencimento para que cada vez mais vidas sejam transformadas.

Valorizamos muito as nossas pessoas e prezamos pelo respeito às diversidades. Tratamos adultos como adultos, temos foco no 80/20 e muita paixão pelo que fazemos. Não à toa, somos GPTW Minas Gerais por 8 anos consecutivos e já conquistamos o Ranking GPTW Tecnologia 2 vezes 🏆

E pra esse time ficar completo, só falta você! #VemPraQueima

Por quê a Queima Diária está fazendo um banco de talentos para pessoas com deficiência?

A Queima Diária acredita no poder transformacional da diversidade. Sabemos que para continuar transformando a vida de nossos clientes, precisamos de um time diverso, em todos os sentidos.

Por isso, e por saber da falta de representatividade de pessoas com deficiência na força de trabalho brasileira, criamos um banco de talentos para dar oportunidades para quem desejar trabalhar conosco. Queremos mudar essa realidade, começando por nosso próprio time. Vamos com a gente?

Como funciona o nosso banco de talentos?

Nosso banco de talentos serve para encontrar talentos incríveis para o nosso time. Cada inscrição é revisada e exploramos os potenciais em cada uma de nossas áreas. Quando identificamos uma oportunidade, começamos o nosso processo seletivo, que inclui entrevistas de fit cultural, testes e entrevistas com gestores.

Principais áreas em que estamos recrutando:

  • Administrativo
  • Atendimento | CX
  • Audiovisual
  • Comunicação
  • Design
  • TI
  • CRM
  • Data Analytics
  • Financeiro
  • Growth
  • Infraestrutura
  • Mídias Sociais

raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

International growth is next for Grüns, and this role is how we make it real. You'll own our paid media engine across the UK, EU, Canada, and ANZ, launching and scaling Meta and Google from the ground up in each market. This isn't a strategy seat. You'll build the campaigns, the tracking, and the playbooks yourself, then build the team around what works.

Location:

While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Europe will be most successful in this role.

The team members you’ll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate.

More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Launch and scale Meta and Google campaigns across our priority international markets, including the UK, Canada, ANZ, and key EU markets like Germany
  • Own measurement end to end: CAPI, GA4, GDPR-compliant tracking, and a regular cadence of incrementality and lift testing
  • Scale spend into the millions annually while protecting CAC, LTV/CAC, and contribution margin
  • Build a repeatable testing engine across creative, audience, offer, and localized landing pages
  • Partner closely with creative, product, and lifecycle teams to keep execution sharp across markets
  • Build the foundation for a specialist team: hiring plan, workflows, vendor model, once performance is proven
  • Own the quarterly international growth roadmap, including recommendations on new markets and channels

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 5+ years in performance or growth marketing with hands-on paid media ownership, not just oversight
  • Has personally launched and scaled Meta and Google campaigns in at least two international markets (Canada, Australia, UK, or a non-English-speaking EU market like Germany, the Netherlands, or France)
  • Has scaled paid media spend into the millions annually while holding the line on CAC and contribution margin
  • Has real command of GDPR-compliant tracking and measurement, including CAPI, GA4, and incrementality testing
  • Comes from a high-growth DTC, subscription, or eCommerce business with real paid media dependence
  • Has built campaigns in-house rather than at an agency. You've lived with the downstream impact of your own calls, not just made recommendations from the outside

Approach to the role:

  • Operates like an owner of the business, not a specialist waiting to be told what to test next
  • Builds systems and playbooks that repeat, not one-off wins that don't scale
  • Makes sharp decisions with imperfect data and gets more precise as the picture fills in
  • Sees every market as its own puzzle, but never starts from scratch when a proven pattern already exists

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Business Value Consulting team focuses on driving long-term growth and value creation for the largest and most strategic Stripe users. Business Value Consultants play a critical role in translating the technical capabilities of Stripe products into strategic value for customers. We help drive meaningful business outcomes and accelerate decision-making through a consultative approach that aims to build investment confidence and improve CxO conversations.

What you’ll do

Our Business Value Consulting team partners closely with our Go-to-market teams and Enterprise users to articulate the strategic value Stripe will provide for users’ businesses. Value Consultants develop methodologies to measure the financial, strategic, and operational benefits Stripe provides, and use those to develop value propositions, business cases, and ROI justifications for our users.

Responsibilities

  • Build compelling business case presentations and ROI (Return on Investment) analyses aimed at accelerating, justifying, or expanding sales opportunities
  • Create ROI tools for sales and customers for joint business casing
  • Craft high-impact, executive-level narrative and presentations for CxOs while working cross-functionally with our Sales and Presales teams
  • Conduct internal and external research around customers’ businesses, market, industry, and functional trends, and business value analysis
  • Build strong relationships with regional sales leaders to be a key driver on strategic account planning and engagements
  • Create assets for internal teams to articulate and measure the value of Stripe and deliver high-level business value impact in a consistent way
  • Contribute to the creation and management of library assets including value frameworks, and other sales and value capture assets to help scale the team's reach across the organization
  • Provide thought leadership, training, and consultative partnering with internal sales and other teams throughout and beyond the sales cycle

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in management consulting, business value consulting, strategic finance, or similar roles
  • Strong financial acumen and demonstrated expertise in building compelling executive-ready ROI models, business cases, and financial frameworks (value metrics, cost-benefit analysis, TCO/TVO) that directly influence buying decisions
  • Executive presence and storytelling ability to translate complex financial narratives into clear, persuasive presentations that resonate with C-suite buyers
  • Proven ability to partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Customer Success to shape deal strategy and accelerate revenue outcomes
  • Self-starter who is comfortable managing multiple concurrent engagements with rigor, balancing speed and analytical precision independently

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the technology, SaaS, or fintech industry
  • Background in payments, financial services, or digital commerce
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
  • Track record of developing scalable frameworks and methodologies
  • Understanding of value selling methodologies and sales processes

Our client is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager or Assistant Controller with a strong background in U.S. accounting to support the financial operations of a growing homecare, hospice, and home health organization.

This role will focus on maintaining accurate financial records, supporting the monthly close process, preparing financial reports, and strengthening accounting procedures across the organization.

Reporting directly to the CFO, the selected candidate will play an important role in ensuring reliable financial information, improving accounting workflows, and supporting the company's continued growth. This position is well suited for a hands-on accounting professional ready to take on broader responsibilities within a U.S.-based organization.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and support the monthly close process, ensuring timely and accurate financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Maintain the general ledger and prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, debt schedules, payroll-related accounts, and intercompany transactions.
  • Perform balance-sheet reconciliations and investigate discrepancies to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records.
  • Apply U.S. GAAP and accrual-basis accounting principles consistently across multiple entities, locations, departments, and service lines.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports and assist with budget-to-actual comparisons, variance analysis, and other management reporting for the CFO.
  • Collaborate with the Payroll Lead and Billing Manager to reconcile payroll, billing, collections, revenue, and related accounting activity.
  • Support year-end financial statement audits or reviews by preparing schedules, gathering documentation, and coordinating with external accountants and tax advisors.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, internal controls, reporting accuracy, and month-end close efficiency.
  • Maintain and improve accounting workflows using QuickBooks Online, Excel, Power BI, Reach Reporting, or similar tools.
  • Assist the CFO with ad hoc financial analysis, reporting requests, and accounting projects as needed.
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for month-end close and financial reporting.
  • Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, Senior Accountant, or in a comparable role with increasing responsibilities.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual-basis accounting, preferably within a U.S.-based company.
  • Experience preparing financial statements, reconciling balance-sheet accounts, reviewing general ledger activity, and maintaining accurate accounting records.
  • Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate financial information clearly and collaborate directly with the CFO.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage deadlines and work independently in a remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • CPA designation or progress toward a relevant accounting certification.
  • Experience in healthcare services, particularly home health, homecare, hospice, or other multi-location service organizations.
  • Experience supporting companies with $25 million or more in annual revenue.
  • Familiarity with accounting across multiple legal entities, locations, departments, or service lines.
  • Experience supporting external financial statement audits or reviews.
  • Exposure to process improvement initiatives, accounting automation, and month-end close optimization.
  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB), AxisCare, Power BI, Reach Reporting, or similar healthcare and financial reporting systems.
Work Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, with required overlap with U.S. business hours. The final schedule will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

Team Structure

The role works closely with the CFO and collaborates with the Payroll Lead and Billing Manager. This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports, offering an opportunity to take ownership of core accounting processes while contributing to the development and improvement of the company's finance function.

Job Summary:

The Director, Compliance is responsible for establishing a baseline of compliance risk, identifying areas of potential exposure, developing and aligning compliance risk management strategies with CareSource goals and objectives, and executing the compliance program ensuring effectiveness.

Essential Functions:

  • Serves as the program compliance officer for an assigned CareSource program and will be responsible for building and maintaining a strong relationship and goodwill with the relevant regulatory entity
  • Assist the Chief Compliance Officer and their designees with the implementation of an effective compliance program
  • Oversee all activities related to the assigned program’s regulatory and sub regulatory guidance and changes; Ensure timely responses to regulator requests, audit deliverables, and investigations; and ensure required changes are effectively implemented
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with business units and internal support functions to help ensure that all compliance requirements have been met; risk is monitored and remediated through testing/ development/ implementation and use
  • Remain current and help drive interpretation and implementation of federal/state laws and regulations regarding Medicaid, Medicare and Marketplace requirements, as applicable, as well as general compliance and delegation oversight best practices and industry standards
  • Provide key insights for the creation and execution of the annual compliance work plan and risk assessment activities
  • Manage and drive effective usage of compliance tools and data for the compliance tracking systems
  • Oversee assigned program performance of applicable compliance oversight functions such as corrective action plan management, ongoing monitoring, and annual audits
  • Develop reporting of key statistics and trends of core compliance and oversight functions, identifying risk mitigation and performance improvement opportunities to the Delegation Oversight and Compliance Committees as well as to compliance and company leadership
  • Perform data analysis and reporting activities. Provide and maintain oversight reporting mechanisms, and track and report outcomes from compliance activities. Collect, organize, and distribute reports and documents and recommend enhancements to reporting compliance tools
  • Track and trend issues to identify compliance risk and performance improvement opportunities; provide input for executive compliance reporting
  • Assist with regulatory audits and drive audit readiness activities for assigned program
  • Assist teams in interpreting audit findings against audit findings, prepare and complete audit responses and oversee the development of effective corrective actions
  • Collaborate with internal resources on the production and communication of compliance related alerts, newsletters and educational materials for company workforce
  • Establish effective working relationships and build creditability within the organization to support a culture of compliance based on the company's core values
  • Report potential risks, non-compliance or alleged violations to Compliance leadership and plan leadership
  • Work with the business, regulatory and legal to help ensure proper interpretation and implementation of such laws, regulations, guidance, contracts and similar regulatory requirements (collectively “laws”). Ensure direct line leadership and the Chief Compliance Officer are informed of all material regulatory initiatives, compliance concerns, operational issues and associated corrective actions/remediation impacting CareSource
  • Provide management and oversight of professional staff
  • Partner with the Corporate Privacy Officer to ensure a comprehensive and effective HIPAA Privacy compliance program is in place to meet federal, state and accreditation requirements
  • Perform any other job duties as requested

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business/Healthcare Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent years of relevant work experience are required
  • Masters of Business Administration (MBA), Juris Doctorate or other advanced degree, is preferred
  • A minimum of five (5) years of relevant work experience within health plan operations is required, with at least three (3) years directly involved in government programs or managed care compliance activities preferred
  • Three (3) years of management experience is required
  • Centers for Medicare & Medicaid program experience, State Medicaid Agency program experience or qualified health plan (i.e. marketplace) experience is required

Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:

  • Advanced capabilities in MS Office suite including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Ability to motivate, influence, and lead matrixed and cross-functional teams
  • Excellent relationship management skills that will build and maintain strong working relationships in a matrix environment and influence action across the organization around risk management
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with all levels of management within the organization and across multiple organizational layers
  • Excellent analysis, attention to detail, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity - integrate, prioritize and rollout programs without clearly defined guidelines
  • Experience in a high-growth business environment
  • Working knowledge of health plan environment is preferred
  • Strong analytical skills, effective problem-solving skills, and attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-past environment
  • Ability to develop, prioritize and accomplish goals
  • Knowledge of regulatory environment and regulators (CMS/HHS/DOI/ Medicaid)

Licensure and Certification:

  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) preferred

Working Conditions:

  • General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time

Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Director, Systems Field Service is responsible for leading FormFactor's global field service organization supporting Systems capital equipment products and customers. This leader owns field service strategy, operational execution, customer satisfaction, field resource planning, service readiness, and service delivery performance across a global service network.


The position is accountable for ensuring scalable support for production and development customers, driving consistent service standards worldwide, improving operational efficiency, and partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Management, Quality, and Service Centers to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.


The Director will lead a global team of Field Service Engineers and regional service leaders while driving continuous improvement initiatives that improve uptime, reduce repair cycle times, increase customer satisfaction, and support revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities:


Global Field Service Leadership

  • Lead the global Systems Field Service organization across North America, Asia, Europe, and other key customer regions.
  • Establish service delivery strategies aligned with business growth objectives and customer requirements.
  • Develop organizational capabilities, workforce plans, and succession strategies to support future growth.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, customer focus, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Customer Support & Service Delivery

  • Own field service performance, customer satisfaction, and service execution.
  • Ensure field support readiness for high-volume manufacturing, new customer ramps, and strategic programs.
  • Develop and maintain customer-specific service delivery plans for key accounts.
  • Lead executive-level customer engagements during critical escalations and business reviews.
  • Monitor and improve uptime, MTTR, service responsiveness, and overall customer experience.

Field Operations Management

  • Establish capacity models, staffing plans, and geographic coverage strategies.
  • Optimize field service resource deployment to align with customer demand and service commitments.
  • Drive standardization of field service processes, reporting, and operational metrics.
  • Ensure effective coordination between on-site service teams, regional service centers, and technical support organizations.
  • Manage global service readiness for new site launches and expanded customer support programs.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to define service requirements for major customer opportunities.

Technical Support & Escalations

  • Partner with Technical Support Engineering to establish escalation processes and resolution standards.
  • Ensure timely resolution of complex customer issues and systemic product concerns.
  • Lead field feedback loops that continuously improve product quality, reliability, and serviceability.
  • Champion root-cause analysis and corrective action initiatives across the organization.

Service Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop annual operating plans, headcount models, and investment proposals.
  • Drive achievement of operational KPIs, including:
    • Customer Satisfaction
    • Response Time
    • First-Time Right
    • MTTR
    • Revenue Performance
    • Service Margin
    • Productivity
    • Escalation Closure
  • Support service revenue growth through value-added service offerings and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Participate in strategic planning for future service infrastructure, service centers, and on-site support models.

Talent Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing global service team.
  • Establish global training, certification, and competency programs.
  • Build leadership capability across regional service organizations.
  • Foster employee engagement and career development throughout the service organization.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related technical discipline.
  • Experience in technical service, field operations, semiconductor equipment, or customer support leadership experience.
  • Experience leading global service organizations and multi-regional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing, test, or advanced technology environments.
  • Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, operational metrics, and strategic initiatives.
  • Proven success leading customer escalations and executive-level customer engagements.
  • Experience with semiconductor capital equipment, wafer test, or related test technologies.
  • Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of Foundry, IDM, Fabless, and OSAT business models.
  • Experience building global service organizations and support infrastructure.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.

Key Success Metrics:

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Service-Level Achievement
  • Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
  • First-Time Right (FTR)
  • Escalation Closure Performance
  • Field Productivity
  • Employee Engagement
  • Training and Certification Compliance
  • Operational Cost Efficiency

Leadership Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Global Leadership
  • Talent Development
  • Change Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Executive Communication
  • Decision Making
  • Accountability

Skills:

Accountability, Change Management, Collaboration, Customer-Focused, Decision Making, Executive Communications, Global Leadership, Operational Excellence, Strategic Thinking, Talent Development

Minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience in leadership roles, with a Bachelor’s degree; or 10 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 8 years experience; or equivalent experience | Required

raw.description:
Payroll Manager

  • Location: Remote (LATAM, Philippines, or India). You must keep at least 5 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours.
  • Compensation: $3,200 - $3,600 USD per month ($38,400 - $43,200 annually)
  • Reports to: VP of Finance
  • Team: Finance


About TubeScience

  • TubeScience is a performance-driven creative and media company that helps brands create, test, and scale high-performing video advertising.
  • We work in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where accuracy, ownership, and thoughtful service matter.
  • We’re looking for an experienced payroll professional to fully own U.S. payroll, contractor payments, and Employer of Record (EOR) payroll support across the company, and to help build the payroll function as we grow.
  • This role is hands-on, with no direct reports to start. You’ll run payroll independently, solve complex issues, and build reliable processes and controls. It calls for professional maturity, independent judgment, and deep, hands-on U.S. payroll expertise.

The Role

  • You’ll be the company’s payroll owner, accountable for how payroll runs from start to finish. You’ll partner closely with Finance, HR, Accounting, employees, and external payroll partners.
  • Success in this role means our people are paid accurately and on time, payroll data stays clean, and discrepancies are resolved quickly. It also means our processes stay compliant and audit-ready as the company grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Own regular and off-cycle U.S. payroll processing in Rippling.
  • Validate payroll inputs, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, deductions, and reimbursements.
  • Administer and reconcile contractor payments.
  • Coordinate payroll and bonus processing for employees engaged through EOR partners.
  • Validate EOR payroll calculations, and reconcile invoices and statements against internal records.
  • Manage multi-state payroll requirements, including tax withholding, overtime, final pay, state registrations, tax notices, filings, and reconciliations.
  • Administer benefits deductions, garnishments, retirement contributions, and other payroll deductions.
  • Keep payroll and employee data in Rippling accurate, and troubleshoot configurations, reports, workflows, and records.
  • Investigate payroll discrepancies, find root causes, and drive issues through to resolution.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll questions.
  • Support payroll-related audits, census requests, and benefits or insurance reviews.
  • Manage year-end payroll activities, including W-2/1099 processing, annual reconciliations, and related tax requirements.
  • Build and maintain payroll SOPs and controls, and find ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and audit readiness.

Who You Are

You’re an experienced payroll professional who has directly owned U.S. payroll. Your experience goes beyond coordinating payroll inputs for another person or provider to process.

You have:

  • 5+ years of payroll experience, including at least 3 years directly administering U.S. payroll.
  • Hands-on experience processing payroll in Rippling.
  • Experience managing multi-state U.S. payroll. California and/or New York experience is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience applying California overtime rules, tax exemptions, and state final-pay requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. payroll taxes, wage deductions, federal and state requirements, and off-cycle payroll.
  • Experience independently investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, particularly for reconciliations and payroll reporting.
  • Strong numerical reasoning and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Professional fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Strong communication and customer-service skills for handling sensitive employee payroll questions.
  • The ability to work independently, manage recurring deadlines, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Experience

  • Payroll tax registrations, notices, and agency correspondence.
  • 401(k), workers’ compensation, or payroll tax audits.
  • Employee census requests and benefits reconciliations.
  • EOR payroll administration.
  • Contractor payment administration.
  • Year-end W-2 and 1099 processing.
  • Supporting a U.S.-based company remotely from outside the U.S.
  • Building or maturing a payroll function at a startup or high-growth company.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Take ownership of problems from the moment you spot them until they’re resolved.
  • Care deeply about accuracy and catch discrepancies others might miss.
  • Are comfortable investigating complex payroll issues on your own.
  • Balance strong controls with the need to move quickly.
  • Communicate clearly and patiently with employees and internal stakeholders.
  • Want to shape how payroll operates, making processes more reliable rather than just following existing ones.

This Role Probably Isn’t For You If…

  • Your payroll experience has mostly involved collecting or submitting information for someone else to process.
  • You haven’t directly administered U.S. payroll.
  • You don’t have hands-on experience with Rippling.
  • You prefer HR-generalist work over deep payroll ownership.
  • You’re looking to manage a team rather than own payroll hands-on.

Why TubeScience

  • You’ll own a critical operational function that directly affects employees across the company.
  • You’ll work closely with senior Finance and HR leaders and build the payroll function: how it operates, its controls, and how it scales with the business.
  • If you’re an experienced U.S. payroll professional who values accuracy and ownership, and you like solving problems from start to finish, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Telehealth Mental Health Therapist – Remote

Please note: This is a state-specific application. If you are not currently licensed in New Mexico, we encourage you to visit www.affect.com to view our active openings by state.

If you do not see a current opportunity in your state, we still welcome you to submit your information through our General Application for Future Openings, also available on our website. We’d love to keep your details on file for future consideration.

About AffectBuilding on our success in substance use disorder care, Affect has expanded its services to include high-quality, accessible mental health treatment. Our model brings together licensed therapists, innovative technology, and a deeply human approach to help people manage anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges—on their terms.

As we grow, we’re seeking skilled, compassionate licensed mental health professionals to join our remote care team. If you're a New Mexico licensed LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW looking to make an impact through virtual care, we’d love to connect.

Our ability to provide supervision for non-independent mental health professionals varies by state and license, but we also encourage you to apply. We try to support non-independent licenses when possible.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct diagnostic assessments and collaboratively develop evidence-based treatment plans
  • Provide individual psychotherapy sessions via secure telehealth platforms
  • Support Members with a wide range of mental health needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges with flexibility to work with members with substance use disorders at times.
  • Maintain clear and timely clinical documentation in our electronic medical record (EMR) system. Affect provides an AI-powered clinical scribe to assist with documentation, helping reduce administrative burden and allowing clinicians to spend more time focused on member care.
  • Coordinate care as needed and contribute to a supportive, multidisciplinary environment
  • Participate in clinical team meetings and optional case consultations
  • Adhere to HIPAA and all applicable state licensure regulations

Requirements:

  • Active and verifiable license from one of the following New Mexico licenses: LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW as well as your state of residence if it is not New Mexico. All credentials must be verified through the State Board’s website as part of the application process
  • Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings
  • Strong communication and clinical skills with a person-centered, trauma-informed approach
  • Comfort with EMRs, Google Suite or Microsoft Office, and telehealth tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity
  • Have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace and reliable internet

The Benefits of Joining Affect

  • The salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 - $80,000 and will commensurate with experience and professional license.
  • Full-time employees may enroll in offered medical, dental, and vision coverage and employer paid life and disability insurance also provided. Employees may enroll in Affect's company’s 401k plan.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, company observed holidays and parental leave is provided to full-time employees.
  • Remote work options with full-time and part-time schedules
  • AI-powered clinical scribe technology to streamline documentation and reduce administrative workload
  • Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
  • Supportive team culture focused on impact, collaboration, and innovation
  • Be part of building a modern, inclusive, and accessible mental health care system

Join us as we expand our mission—empowering recovery, healing, and hope through digital-first mental health care.

raw.description:
Statement of the Position:

Coordinates with the Funding Manager, Funding Supervisor, Branch Manager, Rehabilitation Technology Supplier (RTS), and other office support personnel to ensure all operational procedures are completed in accordance with company policy and within expected time frames. Responsible for the complete funding transaction cycle including Coding & Pricing, gathering information and documents pertinent to the funding package, ensuring that all documentation is in place, submission to the funding sources and collecting payer decisions including authorizations, denials, and deferrals.

Company Description:

At all levels, working at National Seating & Mobility provides the opportunity to directly impact our client’s lives by giving them self-reliance and independence. Our teams are comprised of passionate individuals, dedicated to providing the best care to each client. We focus on abilities by leveraging technology and creating mobility solutions that are as unique as our client’s needs.

Working at National Seating & Mobility is an opportunity to build a meaningful career, while leaving a lasting impact on the lives of those we serve. Located in more than 40 states, we strive for diversity and offer an array of benefits including 401k, company paid Long Term Disability, and tuition reimbursement.

Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:

1. Manages transaction cycle time (TCT) from Ready to Process to Final Funding Approval, making certain that all necessary steps are taken in the appropriate order ensuring timeliness of process and quality of funding approval.

2. Obtains any required missing demographics and ensures that all client information (Minimum Documentation Requirement) is correct and is put into the work order.

3. Verifies client benefits and coverage and communicates benefit information to client.

4. Gathers and reviews documentation for funding package, including but not limited to: proper prescriptions, Letters of Medical Necessity (LMN), RTS evaluation information, price lists, forms (AOB, ABN, rent or purchase letter).

5. Communicates regularly with Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients in an effort to secure documentation as required by payer.

6. Communicates changes and escalations in the process and collects needed information from branch personnel, Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients.

7. Investigates and updates any payer requirements in the UPD.

8. Maintains communication with client throughout the process when applicable, including notifying them of financial responsibility.

9. Follows up with payer sources in order to obtain timely authorization, by properly working the Funding Work Queue.

10. Requests and obtains proper approval for work order credit exceptions.

11. Conducts pre-purchase quality assurance to ensure all approvals and requirements are met prior to purchase of equipment.

12. Conducts pre-delivery verification to ensure all approvals and requirements are met prior to delivery of equipment.

13. Coordinates with other funding areas and responsible for completing all tasks in the Action Required queue.

14. Performs any related job duties assigned by the Funding Manager or Funding Supervisor. Carries out all position expectations in a professional manner and with minimal supervision.

15. Responsible to complete all continuing education requirements to include assigned NSM University courses.

16. Must maintain regular and predictable attendance.

Work Environment:

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands repetitively to operate standard office equipment. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms.

Required Education, Experience, & Competencies:

  • 2 years’ experience in Complex Rehab Technology, Medical Billing, or Funding preferred
  • High school diploma or G.E.D.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee. He/She will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties requested by his/her supervisor.

Job Title: Business/Operations AnalystJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: NoneType of Travel: None* * *

The Opportunity:
We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to work in a fast-paced Operations and Maintenance (O&M) environment as part of the IFAMS (Momentum) Business Operations team. This role involves supporting both technical and functional stakeholders and ensuring the continuity of day-to-day processing operations. The team handles scheduled and ad hoc requests, data fixes, Control-M batch cycles, annual close support, wave go-lives, and troubleshooting across the system. Some evening and weekend work will be required to support operational needs.


Responsibilities:

  • The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on functional and technical skills, production support experience, automation capabilities, and the ability to partner with cross-functional teams to maintain and improve operational workflows.
  • Work with technical operations team to support batch processes, job monitoring, and maintenance activities.
  • Work in a fast-paced IFAMS (Momentum) Operations & Maintenance environment supporting both technical and functional teams.
  • Handle day-to-day O&M tasks including scheduled batch runs, ad hoc requests, data fixes, and problem resolution.
  • Support annual financial close cycles, wave go-lives, and operational readiness activities.
  • Write complex SQL queries to support reporting, validation, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Develop and maintain Perl and Shell scripts for automation, file processing, and workflow improvements.
  • Use Control-M or other scheduling tools to manage batch job setup, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and file verification activities.
  • Utilize GitHub or similar version control systems for script and configuration management.
  • Troubleshoot operational and technical issues across logs, job histories, and data flows.
  • Use Jira, Agility, or similar tools for task management and issue tracking.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and follow Agile workflow practices.
  • Organize and track assigned work, ensuring timely completion of tasks.
  • Develop and maintain Java code supporting operational tools or integration components.
  • Work with Web Services, APIs, and FTP integrations for system connectivity and file transfers.
  • Provide evening and weekend support as required for critical operations.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Strong SQL expertise with the ability to write complex and optimized queries.
  • Hands-on experience with Perl and Shell scripting for automation.
  • Experience with Linux navigation, troubleshooting, and basic server operations.
  • Experience with Control-M or equivalent batch scheduling tools.
  • Experience with GitHub or other version control platforms.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Agility.
  • Basic experience with Java programming supporting operational utilities..
  • Ability to work evening and weekend shifts as operationally required.


Desired:

  • Previous experience supporting the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).
  • Understanding of AI prompting and ability to work with tools like Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT.
  • 3+ years experience in technical operations, production support, or system operations roles.
  • Experience working with OpenShift environments.
  • Working understanding of Web Services, APIs, and FTP integrations
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
Position:Sales-Operations Coordinator
Reports to:Associate Manager, Sales-Operations
Department:High School Outbound
Location: US Remote (and Canada when applicable)

Who we are:

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

    • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
    • You will receive a competitive total rewards package.CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
      • Paid time off and Parental leave
      • Gym Reimbursement Program
      • Employee Assistance Program
      • Short-term & Long-term Disability
      • 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
      • CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
      • 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
      • Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
      • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts (medical and dependent)
      • Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study-abroad locations, with facilities and staff in 30 countries.  Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year.  Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

The Sales Operations Coordinator serves as the operational systems and process expert for the Global Navigator High School Study Abroad team. This role owns and coordinates key operational workflows, including application management, enrollment processes, student systems, billing support, learning platforms, reporting, and process documentation. Working closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Information Technology, and cross-functional teams, the Coordinator ensures accurate execution of operational processes, provides timely support on customer and Sales inquiries, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency through systems and process improvements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically proficient, detail-oriented, and enjoys solving problems through process improvement and technology.

What you’ll do:

  • Application & Systems Management: Maintain and improve student application and enrollment systems, including testing updates, troubleshooting issues, managing system configurations, and supporting ongoing platform enhancements. Serve as the primary operational resource for Sales and internal teams regarding application workflows, system functionality, and process-related questions.
  • Operational Process Coordination: Own and coordinate operational workflows that support the student lifecycle, including application processes, enrollment steps, language testing, travel insurance, scholarship administration, and other department initiatives. Provide guidance to Sales and internal teams on process requirements, timelines, and next steps while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Learning Management & Student Resources: Maintain student Pre-Departure courses and learning content within Canvas; support updates, testing, and continuous improvements to online learning resources and enrollment processes; collaborate with the Study Abroad Advisors to ensure accurate and up to date content.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Management: Develop, maintain, and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, user guides, and operational documentation to support consistent execution across the Global Navigator High School Study Abroad team. Partner with subject matter experts, including Study Abroad Advisors, to ensure documentation accurately reflects program requirements and operational processes.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain operational data, perform audits, generate reports, and support data integrity across department systems to inform decision-making and ensure accurate student records.
  • Technical Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary operational support resource for Sales and internal stakeholders regarding applications, enrollment processes, billing inquiries, financial statements, student systems, and department platforms. Collaborate with IT and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and ensure effective operational workflows.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Support: Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Sales and internal stakeholders regarding application status, enrollment processes, billing inquiries, financial statements, system-related questions, and administrative requirements. Communicate process updates, deadlines, and workflow expectations to ensure accurate and consistent execution across teams. Partner with Study Abroad Advisors and other cross-functional teams to align operational communications with program requirements and customer expectations.
  • Process Improvement & Technology Optimization: Analyze workflows, identify operational challenges, test system enhancements, and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and the overall user experience.
  • Operational Support: Participate in annual in-person trainings and ongoing professional development; provide operational support during travel weekends in the summer and peak program periods, including occasional evening, weekend, and travel responsibilities as needed; perform other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring:

The ideal candidatewillpossess:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Two or more years of professional experience in operations, project coordination, systems administration, customer support, or a related field.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn, troubleshoot, and optimize multiple software platforms and systems.
  • Experience working with CRM, application management, learning management, database, or project management systems; Salesforce and Canvas experience preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with formulas, large datasets, reporting, and data analysis; experience with automation or advanced reporting tools is preferred.
  • Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement practical, scalable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing SOPs, training materials, and process documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background, reference, education, and employment check will be conducted as a condition of employment.

raw.title: Sr. Scrum Master/Project Manager
raw.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
raw.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is the primary guiding authority for Agile ceremonies, structure, and delivery discipline across the engineering organization. This role sets and enforces the standard for how Agile is practiced organization-wide — directly coaching and overseeing a cohort of Scrum Masters across a broad portfolio of teams, while personally serving as the acting Scrum Master for a subset of teams to stay close to day-to-day delivery. The role owns the organization's Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework end-to-end, translating Jira and GitHub activity into trustworthy delivery and quality signals for engineering and business leadership. The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is also the primary Agile conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and the engineering teams, ensuring scaled Agile practices connect roadmap intent to sprint execution cleanly and predictably.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1. Agile Program Leadership & Scrum Master Coaching

  • Set and enforce the standard for Agile ceremonies and structure across 12 teams; directly coach and performance-support 6–7 Scrum Masters.
  • Maintain a consistent Agile operating model (definitions of ready/done, estimation, cadences, escalation paths) across all teams.
  • Resolve cross-team delivery impediments and run a Scrum Master community of practice.

2. Direct Scrum Mastery

  • Act as Scrum Master for 2 assigned teams — ceremonies, backlog hygiene, and impediment removal — to stay grounded in day-to-day delivery.

3. Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework

Own, implement, and evolve a comprehensive Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework spanning sprint execution, code review discipline, and defect accountability — from first commit through production — using Jira and GitHub as the systems of record.

  • Implement and maintain core delivery metrics in Jira — velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, scope creep, and carryover rate — at team, sprint, and rolling-quarter cadence.
  • Implement code review rigor metrics from GitHub pull request activity, including change-requested rate, rework commits per PR, review cycles to approval, time in review, and senior reviewer
  • comment density; partner with engineering leadership to maintain branch protection rules and senior-reviewer group definitions that keep this data complete.
  • Own the defect discovery-by-phase taxonomy on the Bug issue type in Jira (Unit/TDD, Code Review, Dev/Integration Testing, QA/Release Testing, Production/Escaped) and the resulting metrics: defect detection distribution, escape rate, production escape rate, phase containment effectiveness, defect density, and mean time to detect.
  • Maintain the escaped-defect attribution chain, linking each bug ticket back to its originating story/task, the merged pull request(s) that implemented it, and the author and reviewers of record, via Jira links and GitHub smart-commit/PR referencing, enabling accountability rollups in either direction.
  • Own the recurring per-release and quarterly Contractor/Team Accountability Rollup reporting cycle, and ensure trend lines (improving, flat, or worsening) are reviewed with the relevant teams and leads, not just presented in aggregate.
  • Own the reporting and BI delivery mechanic for the framework — including administration of eazyBI (or equivalent BI layer) connected to Jira and GitHub — to produce recurring dashboards and reports for engineering and business stakeholders without requiring a separate data pipeline.
  • Continuously refine the framework's guiding principles: metrics must be actionable, paired for balance (speed vs. quality), system-focused rather than individual-focused (with defect attribution as the narrow, explicitly scoped exception), trend-driven, diagnostic rather than target-driven, and passively instrumented from existing Jira/GitHub workflow artifacts.

4. Agile Conduit for Product Management

  • Serve as the primary Agile conduit between Product Managers, Product Owners, and the engineering organization, translating roadmap and portfolio intent into scaled Agile execution across the 12 teams.
  • Apply scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or the organization's equivalent) to coordinate cross-team dependencies, program increment / release planning, and backlog alignment between Product and Engineering.
  • Facilitate program-level ceremonies (e.g., PI planning, scrum-of-scrums, cross-team dependency reviews) that connect Product Owner intent with the delivery capacity and constraints of the 12 teams.
  • Provide Product Management and Product Ownership with visibility into delivery health and quality signals from the Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework to inform prioritization and roadmap tradeoffs.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Performance at this level is evaluated across four dimensions:

Agile Program Delivery

  • Ceremonies across all 12 teams consistently meet the organization's defined Agile standard, with impediments identified and escalated proactively rather than discovered after the fact.
  • The 2 directly run teams deliver predictably, with healthy sprint predictability and carryover metrics.

Metrics & Quality Accountability

  • The Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework remains accurate, current, and trusted — data completeness (linkage, tagging, discovery-phase fields) is maintained across teams.
  • Reporting and BI dashboards are delivered on a reliable cadence and are actively used by engineering and business leadership in decision-making.

Organizational Impact & Coaching

  • Scrum Masters who report into this role demonstrably improve in facilitation quality, impediment resolution, and Agile maturity over time.
  • Escaped-defect and code-review-rigor trends across teams move in a positive direction release over release.

Leadership & Communication

  • Serves as a trusted, low-friction conduit between Product and Engineering, with dependencies and tradeoffs surfaced early rather than at the point of conflict.
  • Communicates delivery risk, quality trends, and program status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager in a professional software development environment, including experience coaching or leading other Scrum Masters.
  • Demonstrated experience running Agile ceremonies and delivery practices across multiple concurrent teams.
  • Working knowledge of scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, LeSS) and experience serving as a conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and engineering teams.
  • Hands-on proficiency administering Jira for Agile delivery, including custom fields, workflows, and sprint/board configuration.
  • Working knowledge of GitHub pull request workflows, branch protection, and Jira–GitHub linkage (smart commits) sufficient to own a metrics framework built on that data.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and evolve delivery and quality metrics programs, and to translate them into reporting that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification; SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Program Consultant) a plus.
  • Direct experience administering eazyBI (or a comparable BI/reporting layer) against Jira and GitHub data.
  • Experience building or maturing a defect discovery and escaped-defect attribution framework.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The desired salary must be indicated for the application to be considered.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Equal Opportunity Employer – RealTime eClinical Solutions strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including employment.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility.

Thank you for your interest in RealTime eClinical Solutions.
