raw.description:
Department: Victim Services

Position: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer

FLSA Status: Not Specified (Not Applicable)

About RAINN

Since 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started. As the nation's largest anti-sexual violence organization and operator of the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-HOPE), we lead the fight against sexual violence by expanding prevention, ensuring justice, and providing healing to create safer communities.

Our mission is to stop sexual violence by supporting survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and creating safer communities and we do it through three pillars:

Prevention — Educating the public and inspiring action through media, entertainment, and direct outreach

Justice — Leading bipartisan policy campaigns and working to hold every offender accountable

Healing — Providing free, confidential, 24/7 support through the National Sexual Assault Hotline, DoD Safe Helpline, and other programs

Volunteers are at the heart of this work. By joining RAINN, you become part of a movement that has answered millions of calls, shaped national policy, and given hope to survivors across the country.

If you or someone you know needs support, free and confidential help is available 24/7: call 800.656.HOPE (4673), chat at rainn.org, or text HOPE to 64673.

Position Summary

The National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH), operated by RAINN, provides live, secure, anonymous crisis support to the growing number of people who prefer communicating online through a simple instant message format, giving those affected by sexual assault a safe place to receive support.

NSAH volunteers are responsible for providing high-quality services to users of the National Sexual Assault Hotline, including but not limited to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones. Volunteers also receive extensive and ongoing crisis-intervention training as well as professional development and coaching opportunities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Utilize crisis intervention best practices including safety planning, brainstorming, and listening skills to provide compassionate support to hotline users.
  • Complete regular training on serving NSAH users.
  • Answer inbound crisis-intervention online chats to NSAH users.
  • Support NSAH users and provide accurate referral services.
  • Maintain knowledge and adhere to RAINN's and NSAH's policies and protocols.
  • Assist with NSAH specific data collection by completing session assessments during each shift.
  • Attend and participate in any additional training for all NSAH volunteers.

Qualification Requirements

  • Tech-savvy with experience using instant messaging and digital communication platforms.
  • Ability to convey empathy over instant messaging.

  • Ability to type at least 35 words per minute.

  • Ability to work well under pressure and maintain composure during stressful situations; ability to handle shifting and multiple priorities.

  • Ability to solve problems and deal with a wide range of situations.

  • Ability to interpret a variety of written instructions.

  • Ability to exercise good judgment when faced with complex decisions.

  • Ability to receive and implement feedback.

  • Resiliently positive and energetic attitude, with the ability to successfully work on a team and independently.

  • Willingness to work a non-traditional schedule, including evenings and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 1-year of professional experience in one or more of the following:
    • Working with vulnerable populations and/or survivors of sexual violence.
    • Working in human resources, social services, or customer service.
    • Crisis hotline/intervention experience (volunteer or paid position).
  • Experience using an online learning platform.
  • Both literate and fluent in Spanish writing and grammar skills.
    • Ability to pass a proficiency test given during the application process.

Evaluation

  • Volunteers receive real-time positive and constructive feedback from NSAH Staffers who supervise their interactions with hotline visitors.
  • Volunteers have the opportunity to schedule check-ins sessions with the volunteer management team as often as needed for chat debriefs or skill development.
  • Volunteers occasionally receive positive feedback from hotline visitors.

Time Commitment

  • All volunteers are asked to commit to a set-shift on the hotline. This shift is chosen from a weekly, bi-weekly or monthly upon review of the candidate’s application.
  • At least one year or 500 hours of volunteer service.

Training Information

Individuals who are approved will start an estimate of 50 hours of online training:

  • Complete and pass a 40-hour-long online training.
  • Attend and participate in 4 online, live-facilitated sessions, totaling 13 hours.
  • Complete a minimum of two shadowing sessions.
  • Complete practice simulations as assigned throughout training.
  • Complete transcripts or supervised sessions as final evaluation step by the clinical team.

Benefits

  • Volunteers who complete all required training are eligible for the National Advocate Credentialing Program (NACP). Application costs not covered.
  • Receive ongoing support and appreciation opportunities from the NSAH volunteer management team, including access to office hours and chat debrief sessions.
  • Provide much-needed support to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones.
  • Receive extensive, ongoing, and up-to-date crisis intervention training; facilitated by RAINN professionals and completely free of charge.
  • Interact with experts in the field, an array of staff members, and other volunteers nationwide.
  • Work from the comfort of their own home.
  • Develop and continuously practice active listening skills.
  • Access to RAINN’s Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for emotional support and counseling referrals.

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants must be 18 years of age or older at the time of submission, possess a valid U.S. Social Security Number (SSN), and reside within the continental United States (excluding Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and U.S. territories). Upon approval for training, all onboarding volunteers must successfully pass a criminal background check, which is provided free of charge by RAINN.

Holds. Limits. Locks. Closures. The judicious use of these tools is designed to protect good customers. But if wielded maladroitly, good customers get entangled in unnecessary friction, burden our operations teams, and may become detractors and churn. At Mercury, we believe banking* should be empowering and seamless, not difficult, confusing, or stressful.

As a Product Manager for Fraud, you’ll build products that enable Mercury to master these tools and deftly balance customer experience with fraud prevention. You'll develop a deep understanding of our customers, their accounts, and our money movement products to build systems that protect our customers and Mercury from fraud. You’ll work cross-functionally to build products for both end users and internal risk teams that enable Mercury to provide a seamless and safe banking* experience.

We are looking for someone who can lead us in redefining how risk friction is used, measured, and optimized to unlock the seamless, magical banking* experience we believe is possible.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You'll Do:

  • Shape the strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention across your area, from account integrity or money movement to the decisions, controls, and experiences that protect customers
  • Design and execute on the strategic vision to mitigate fraud and improve risk experience at Mercury - including holds, limit structures, step-up verification, and related friction points
  • Craft user journeys that apply appropriate friction based on risk signals while minimizing disruption to good users
  • Build operational and platform tooling to enable our risk and support teams to efficiently manage case volume, exceptions and high-touch cases
  • Partner with data science to develop, deploy, and continuously improve ML models
  • Establish and track metrics that measure both risk effectiveness, operational, and customer experience impact
  • Support the development of Mercury's risk capabilities to scale across our expanding product suite

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of relevant product management experience, including experience within fraud or risk in banking or fintech environments
  • Deep customer empathy and understanding of how risk friction impacts user experience, growth and retention
  • Experience working with complex automated decisioning systems, rules, ML models, real-time data pipelines
  • Proficiency with analytics. An ability to understand performance or rules and ML models, trade-offs with precision/recall and translate understanding into actionable insights and priorities for your teams
  • Strong track record of cross-functional leadership, particularly in navigating tradeoffs between risk, compliance, and customer experience priorities
  • Exceptional communication skills that allow you to translate complex risk concepts into actionable product strategies
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ability to make balanced decisions with imperfect information

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

raw.title: Manager, Fulfillment and Distribution (UK)
raw.excerpt: ABOUT USAt the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

At the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health. Since 2010, we've dedicated ourselves to bringing Foundational Nutrition to people around the world.

Our ethos is deeply rooted in science, with an unwavering dedication to continuous improvement. We leverage and contribute to the latest research to deliver a powerful, straightforward solution for optimal health to our customers. We harness the finest ingredients so that every scoop of AG1 gives you the nutrients you need with the simplicity you want in a daily routine.

Likewise, our organization puts the same energy into creating an environment that is a reflection of the cultural values that define who we are and how we work together. These seven values— One Spectacular Life, Customer Obsessed, Radical Ownership, High Performance, Courage, Amazing Humans and Continuous Pursuit of Excellence —are a representation of the high standards we set, and hold ourselves accountable to, when it comes to building our global team.


THE ROLE

AG1’s last-mile and 3PL network spans EMEA and APAC. This role owns the day-to-day performance of that network: carriers, 3PLs, systems integration, and the data that proves it’s working. Reporting to the Director of International Fulfillment & Distribution, you’ll be the direct owner of our fulfillment and distribution partner relationships across both regions. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You’ll own the function end to end: the carrier and 3PL relationships, the KPIs, the onboarding of new partners and systems, and the data that justifies every decision. You’ll partner daily with our Logistics Coordinators and Supply Chain team, but the accountability for fulfillment and distribution performance sits with you.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience running carrier and 3PL relationships directly, is comfortable across multiple geographies (the operational and customs realities of EMEA and APAC are different, and you know it), and is fluent in the kind of data analysis that justifies a carrier migration, a systems onboarding, or a rate renegotiation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own carrier and 3PL relationships across EMEA and APAC: negotiate rates, hold providers to their SLAs, and run regular tactical and strategic reviews with our last-mile and fulfillment partners.
  • Drive onboarding and migration: lead the onboarding of new carriers, 3PLs, and systems integrations (EDI, WMS, order/carrier platforms) from data validation through go-live, owning data integrity throughout.
  • Own delivery and fulfillment KPIs: cost-to-deliver, on-time performance, and customer delivery experience. Track them, report on them, and drive the improvements they point to.
  • Build the analysis, not just read it: turn delivery and fulfillment data into the financial case for routing, network, or carrier changes.
  • Resolve issues in real time: be the first line of resolution when a 3PL or carrier issue threatens delivery, comfortable digging into an open WRO or tracking discrepancy yourself.
  • Support retail and marketing fulfillment: partner with Customer Happiness, Marketing, and retail accounts to keep launches and B2B fulfillment on track.
  • Own peak-season readiness: carrier capacity planning, cutoff communication, and escalation paths heading into high season.
  • Partner cross-functionally: work daily with Finance on rate and cost decisions, with Tech/Data on reporting and integration fixes, and with the EU/UK Logistics Coordinators on shared workstreams.
  • Flag network risk early, especially across APAC, where local nuance, customs, documentation, local carriers, needs direct, hands-on attention rather than a remote read.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years in last-mile, parcel, or 3PL fulfillment operations in e-commerce, D2C, or CPG, with direct ownership of carrier and 3PL relationships.
  • Experience spanning multiple regions (EMEA and APAC preferred); comfortable with the operational and customs/documentation differences between them.
  • A genuine command of delivery and fulfillment data, you build the analysis yourself, not just read someone else’s dashboard.
  • A track record of carrier or systems (EDI/WMS) onboarding and migration, from validation through go-live.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor who owns a function end to end, without a team underneath them.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills; you can hold a provider accountable to an SLA without burning the relationship.
  • Advanced Excel/data tooling skills; experience with EDI platforms (e.g., SPS Commerce), carrier integrations, or ERP/order systems (e.g., NetSuite) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent English communication, written and verbal; an additional European or Asian language is a plus, not required.
  • Willingness to travel periodically to visit 3PL and carrier partners, typically several trips per year, with the pace increasing around launches and peak season.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentive plans.
  • A 100% remote working environment (excluding Laboratory positions), which has been implemented from day one.
  • A strong company culture that is enforced through the hiring process to ensure values alignment and a highly collaborative team.
  • A mission-driven approach to everything that we do, with an overall goal to significantly improve our customers’ health and wellness.
  • A high-growth, dynamic environment with opportunities for your direct impact to be felt.
  • Paid holidays, company-wide reset and reflect days, and unlimited PTO (based on your country of residence).

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Staff AI Developer to lead the design and delivery of AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an experienced developer who thrives on architectural decisions, can confidently own systems end-to-end, and contributes to technical leadership across the team.

In this role, you will work as a key technical leader on a cross-functional team, defining AI architecture, leading model development and optimization, and solving challenging integration problems. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability are critical. You’ll establish engineering standards, raise the bar on how we build AI systems, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex ML/AI systems end-to-end, owning architecture decisions and driving solutions from research through production at scale
  • Build and evolve scalable ML platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that support reliable, repeatable model development and deployment across teams
  • Set the standard for AI-forward engineering, using tools like Claude and Cursor with sophistication and helping the team adopt them effectively

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product, engineering, and leadership to shape AI strategy and align technical direction with business outcomes
  • Translate complex AI tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities into clear narratives that drive decision-making across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Lead design reviews and technical discussions, raising the bar for engineering rigor and constructive challenge across the team

Leadership & Influence

  • Define AI architecture and engineering standards, bringing depth on tradeoffs, long-term implications, and responsible AI practices
  • Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers, multiplying impact through coaching, code reviews, and pairing on hard problems
  • Take ownership of the most ambiguous and highest-stakes pieces of work, driving them through to production with care for reliability, cost, and safety

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years professional software development experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML systems in production and deep hands-on experience with generative AI development
  • Expert software development background (Python or similar) with strong design sensibilities for scalable, maintainable systems
  • Deep expertise with cloud platforms, including in-depth understanding of AWS services and AWS GenAI offerings
  • Proven track record designing and shipping complex agentic systems in production environments
  • Mastery of AI frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Strong experience with evaluation frameworks and observability tools for LLM apps, including building these capabilities where they don't yet exist
  • Deep understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses, and PII handling
  • Extensive experience building RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases, and advanced retrieval techniques
  • API design experience, including architecting and integrating with internal and third-party services at scale
  • Advanced cost optimization expertise: token economics, caching strategies, model routing, quantization
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and expert knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor

Our salary range is $170,000 - $234,000 CAD

  • Market benchmarking: Lead market pricing studies and survey participation. Analyse results to assess competitiveness, and keep job matches and pricing data current in MarketPay.
  • Salary structures: Develop and maintain salary grades, ranges and pay structures. Review competitiveness each year and recommend changes backed by cost and incumbent analysis.
  • Annual compensation cycle: Run EMEA merit, promotion, bonus and equity processes with global and local teams. You will validate HRIS data for eligible Team Schein Members, prepare review materials, set timelines and manage approvals through to completion.
  • Data quality and reporting: Audit compensation data in Workday and related systems and resolve discrepancies. Produce analyses and reports that support pay decisions, audits and budgeting, and work with HRIS to improve system functionality and workflows.
  • Project leadership and partnership: Lead compensation projects end to end, from scope and timelines to resources and budget. Support Benefits and HRIS initiatives, coordinate virtual teams across countries, manage external providers, and take on other related projects as needed.

Specific Knowledge and Skills

  • Compensation expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of job evaluation, market pricing, survey analysis, salary structures and incentive plan administration.
  • Reward design: Experience designing salary structures, bonus and long-term incentive plans. Equity administration experience is a strong plus.
  • Analytical rigour: Advanced Excel skills and confident use of databases, reporting tools and Microsoft Office. You turn complex compensation data into clear, actionable recommendations and make sound decisions on your own.
  • Commercial acumen: You understand costs, budgets and the business impact of every reward decision, grounded in industry best practice and company policy.
  • Project leadership: You plan, prioritise and deliver multiple projects to deadline while coordinating contributors and sharing your expertise with colleagues.
  • Influence and communication: You present confidently to senior leaders and advise stakeholders. You negotiate well and handle sensitive or difficult compensation conversations with clarity and tact. You write and speak English excellently, and an additional language is a plus.
  • Global partnership: You build trusted relationships at every level and collaborate effectively across countries, functions and virtual teams.

Work Experience

  • Typically 5-7 years of progressively responsible compensation or related HR experience, including job evaluation, market benchmarking, salary structures, annual compensation cycles and incentive administration. Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and working with stakeholders across countries and functions. Equity administration experience is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. A master’s degree or relevant professional certification is an advantage.
  • Travel typically less than 10%. Office environment with no special physical demands.

raw.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager for our Identity teams in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Identity is the foundation every Wellhub product builds on: how subscribers, corporate clients, and partners authenticate and verify who they are, and what they're allowed to do across the ecosystem.

You will own the product vision and roadmap for Identity, including authentication, authorization, user and account management, single sign-on and multi-factor authentication with client and partner systems. You will work closely with Engineering, Infosec, Privacy, Design, Legal, and the product teams that depend on Identity. Your job is to make access secure, simple, and consistent across Wellhub, and to give other teams a platform they can build on with confidence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Every user who signs in, signs up, or manages an account is affected by what the Identity teams build. As Wellhub grows, so does the reach of your work.
  • Your solutions shape critical touchpoints people have with Wellhub: login, account recovery, and account management.
  • You will make it easier and safer for corporate clients to connect their employees through SSO and MFA, and for internal teams to adopt shared identity capabilities instead of building their own.
  • Your decisions directly affect security posture, regulatory compliance, and trust in the platform.
  • You will partner with technical leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver end to end, and you will help raise the product bar across the organization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Set and communicate the product vision and strategy for Identity, and explain its benefits clearly to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Build and manage a high-quality roadmap that balances user experience, security, and platform scalability.
  • Define product requirements in close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Security, Privacy, and Legal, proposing new solutions and continuously improving existing ones.
  • Make trade-offs between friction and protection using data, not intuition.
  • Partner with product teams across Wellhub to understand their identity needs, and prioritize platform capabilities that serve them.
  • Work closely with data, experimentation, design, and engineering to deliver scalable, well-crafted products.
  • Define OKRs, goals, and metrics, such as authentication success rate, account recovery completion, and SSO/MFA adoption, and track their progress.
  • Manage the backlog and lead meetings with stakeholders, engineers, and designers.
  • Develop hypotheses and run A/B experiments to validate them, improving user experience across identity journeys.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You use AI tools to produce high-quality work faster and make better decisions.
  • You have 5+ years of experience leading impactful product development, with a proven track record. Experience on platform or foundational products is a plus.
  • You communicate effectively in English, in writing and in meetings, with colleagues and stakeholders across countries and cultures.
  • You are adaptable and comfortable working with people across different timezones.
  • You are data-driven: you use metrics and insights to iterate and deliver outcomes, and you are comfortable with numbers.
  • You can work through technical complexity. You are comfortable discussing architecture and security trade-offs with engineers, and you can explain them to non-technical stakeholders.
  • You break down complex problems into smaller independent sub-problems, navigate ambiguity, and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments.
  • You influence without authority. You build trust with engineers and cross-functional partners, and you align teams that have competing priorities.
  • You are well organized, handle multiple parallel initiatives, and keep stakeholders informed in a timely way.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Lead Physician to join our Virtual Health Assessment team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

Oscar Medical Group runs a Virtual Health Assessment (VHA) program that outreaches and virtually engages Oscar Health Insurance members in an evaluation and management visit.

The Lead Physician is responsible for delivering quality care to a panel of patients as part of a multidisciplinary team of Physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), Registered Nurses (RNs), and Medical Assistant in a virtual environment. This role will oversee a team of APPs (NPs and PAs) delivering care to their patients and supporting them in Oscar strategic initiatives.

You will report to the Director of Virtual Health Assessment

Working Hours:

We offer a full-time Monday–Friday schedule with 8-hour shifts. One late shift per week and one weekend per quarter are required.

Work Location:

This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Arizona; Arkansas; California; Colorado; District of Columbia; Florida; Georgia; Illinois; Massachusetts; Michigan; Nevada; New Hampshire; New Jersey; New York; North Carolina; Ohio; Pennsylvania; Texas, or Virginia. While your daily work will be completed from your home office, occasional travel may be required for team meetings and company events.

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $237,718 - $312,005 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits including generous PTO, sick and floating holidays, 9 paid holidays, 401k with match and an annual bonus.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide direct high quality, safe patient care via telemedicine (video, phone, messaging) while working with a multidisciplinary team
  • Provide supervision to a group of APPs (NPs and PAs) who are delivering care in a virtual environment and provide professional & clinical growth
  • Clinical escalation point for the care delivery team as needed (APPs, RNs, MAs)
  • Support development of clinical guidelines, continuous improvement of care model, and participate in collaborative projects with Operations and Product team members as a clinical leader
  • Conduct quality assurance audits in addition to required state supervisory audit requirements
  • Ensure a culture of patient safety
  • Be accountable for the quality of care of your patients and ensure superior member experience
  • Conduct service recovery needs for Oscar patients
  • Provide growth and development of your team including management of poor performance
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

Requirements:

  • Must have full practice licensure in good standing in Florida plus at least three of the following states: Arizona; Arkansas; California; Colorado; District of Columbia; Georgia; Illinois; Massachusetts; Michigan; Nevada; New Hampshire; New Jersey; New York; North Carolina; Ohio; Pennsylvania; Texas, or Virginia.
  • Completion of medical residency program; specialty in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Medicine-Pediatrics required.
  • MD or DO from an ACGME accredited medical school
  • ABMS Board Certification corresponding to completed residency program or additional training
  • 5+ years of primary care [or Urgent care] experience
  • Unrestricted license to practice medicine in GA, TX, FL or IMLCC
  • Experience in NP and PA supervision

Bonus points:

  • Spanish language fluency
  • Prior telehealth experience
  • 1+ years experience in supervising teams, including other clinical staff NP and PA supervision
  • Experience being metric driven in a practice setting as it relates to population health management and/or, quality benchmarks, and productivity

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Pay Transparency: Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements.

Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts.

Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. Any Oscar applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the Oscar Benefits Team () to make the need for an accommodation known.

California Residents: For information about our collection, use, and disclosure of applicants’ personal information as well as applicants’ rights over their personal information, please see our Privacy Policy.

raw.description:
College Board – Technology – Security

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

Enterprise Security Engineering (ESE) is the security team responsible for building and operating the foundational security platforms and controls that protect College Board’s enterprise environment. The team owns a broad capability surface spanning security observability, endpoint security, network and edge security, data security, security review management, and AI security.

ESE is both an engineering team and a standards-setting function. The team designs, builds, and operates the controls that protect College Board’s workforce, data, and systems, and it owns the enterprise security standards that operationalize information security policies across the organization.


The team partners across security, Technology, and other organizational divisions to deliver integrated, measurable security outcomes. ESE engineers are technical owners who drive measurable risk reduction through automation, disciplined platform operations, and continuous improvement.

About the Opportunity

As a Security Engineer II, Endpoint Security, you will own the ongoing engineering of College Board’s application allowlist, ensuring only approved software runs on managed endpoints. You will maintain and extend allowlist coverage as software, vendors, and business needs evolve, define and adjust policy as new device groups come online, and process exception requests as they arise. Application allowlisting is a standing control, not a one-time project — it requires continuous engineering to stay effective as the environment changes, and you will make an immediate impact by keeping enforcement current, accurate, and low-friction for the business.

This role partners closely with IT, application owners, and business-unit stakeholders whose software needs must be captured and reflected in the allowlist on an ongoing basis.

In this role, you will:

Allowlist Policy Engineering and Coverage (50%)

  • Maintain and extend the application allowlist baseline as software, vendors, and business needs change
  • Define and adjust allowlist enforcement tiers and rollout sequencing as new device groups or business units come online
  • Test and validate allowlist policy changes before enforcement to minimize business disruption
  • Track and report on device coverage, blocked installs, and open risks

Exception Handling and Policy Maintenance (30%)

  • Process incoming software exception requests, validating business justification against approval criteria
  • Maintain the allowlist as new, approved software and vendor updates are identified
  • Monitor blocked-install attempts to identify gaps, over-broad restrictions, or emerging needs
  • Maintain a knowledge base of allowlist decisions and precedent to support consistent handling of future requests

Team Operations and Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Participate in team routines (planning, standups, retros) and contribute to process improvements
  • Build and maintain documentation, checklists, and runbooks for allowlist policy and exception handling
  • Conduct periodic audits/spot checks of allowlist adherence and exception documentation
  • Continuously build endpoint security expertise through hands-on policy work and cross-team collaboration

About you, you have:

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in cybersecurity, endpoint security, IT operations, or a related technical role
  • Working knowledge of endpoint management and application control concepts
  • Hands-on experience processing exceptions or access requests against defined criteria, with attention to detail and comfort working with structured processes (tickets, checklists, exception workflows)
  • Ability to communicate clearly with end users and business stakeholders about software approvals and restrictions
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with the discipline to keep records accurate and audit-ready
  • Ability and enthusiasm to learn new security tools and technologies as required
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

Nice to have:

  • 1+ years of software or scripting experience (Python, PowerShell, or similar) to support automation of allowlist management or reporting
  • Experience with endpoint management or application control platforms (e.g., Intune, Tanium, Carbon Black, AppLocker)
  • Exposure to IT service management/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow)
  • Relevant certifications (Security+, or an endpoint/EDR vendor certification)
  • Experience working in a regulated or audited environment (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, PCI)

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a practical exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $116,000 - $125,000
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Change & Training / Site Adoption Specialist to drive organizational change management, user training, and adoption activities within a complex SAP transformation environment. The role focuses on preparing business users for new systems, processes, and ways of working by developing effective change management strategies, training programs, and site readiness initiatives. Working closely with project managers, business stakeholders, functional teams, and local site representatives, the specialist ensures successful solution adoption, smooth transitions, and sustainable business outcomes across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute change management and training strategies to support SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout initiatives.
  • Lead organizational change impact assessments, stakeholder analysis, and site readiness evaluations.
  • Design and deliver comprehensive training programs, including instructor-led sessions, virtual training, workshops, and digital learning materials.
  • Develop user guides, training documentation, communication materials, and knowledge transfer resources.
  • Coordinate site adoption activities, ensuring local business teams are prepared for system deployment and process changes.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, local change champions, super users, and business representatives.
  • Monitor training effectiveness, user engagement, adoption metrics, and organizational readiness throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support go-live preparation, hypercare activities, and post-implementation adoption initiatives to ensure smooth business transitions.
  • Identify potential resistance to change, address adoption challenges, and implement continuous improvement measures.
  • Proven experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM), Training, or Business Adoption roles within large-scale IT or business transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of change management methodologies, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness assessment.
  • Experience developing and delivering training strategies, learning materials, and end-user training programs.
  • Hands-on experience coordinating site readiness, user adoption, and change management activities across multiple business locations.
  • Familiarity with SAP implementations, enterprise applications, or digital transformation programs.
  • Experience managing change communication, stakeholder alignment, and business engagement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of change management frameworks such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter, or similar methodologies.
  • Ability to measure training effectiveness, monitor adoption KPIs, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.

Offered benefits

  • Great package: We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, along with an outstanding work environment that fosters long-term career development opportunities.
  • People Focus: Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment.
  • Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops, academies and trainings - inhouse workshops und training (optional)
  • Invest in Your Learning: Access CHF 1,500 (approx. 280k JPY) annually for professional development

Corporate culture and work life balance

  • Flat hierarchies: Speak your mind and grow with close mentoring by senior leaders
  • Remote workstyle: Work from anywhere in Japan (if client project allows)
  • Working location: Temp office in Shinbashi/Client or Project site
  • Work flex: Enjoy 25 days of flexibility to work from your preferred global location (under client’s permission)
  • Annual vacations: of up to 20 days (depending on seniority)
  • Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance, with flexibility beyond standard holiday allowances.
  • Connect as a Team: We use our team’s integration budget to meet, collaborate, and bond
  • Celebrate Your Birthday: Receive a special gift from Fusion on your birthday
  • Anniversary bonus program: Receive substantial bonuses on special work anniversaries (5, 10, 15 years)
  • Bonus programs: 10% annual performance bonus, based on company KPIs.
  • Refer Talent reward program (up to Director) : Offers bonuses if your referral is hired by Fusion
  • Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.

Empowering Global Talent in Life Sciences Transformation

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan remotely and be able to travel to Yamagata upon the client’s requests. We are looking for a potential candidate who can lead the workstream at the client's side as well as large projects in the near future.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

As we are still in the exciting early stages of building our presence in Japan, joining Fusion means you won’t just be another consultant - you will be an initiating member helping shape our Japan growth story locally. You will have the opportunity to work on projects with truly global clients, where diverse perspectives and cross-border collaboration are the norm. You will be acting as the bridge between the global English-speaking business and potentially Japanese speaking local operations. With this comes a high level of accountability and ownership, empowering you to directly influence outcomes and see the tangible impact of your work.

This is a remote work from home position with occasional travel to our properties. Candidates based in Eastern Washington or Idaho are highly preferred. At a minimum, candidates must live in Washington, Idaho, Montana, or California, within driving distance of an 11 Residential community.

Who We Are
11Residential is a property management company specializing in residential multifamily properties in the Western United States. Our mission is to provide a quality living environment that enhances the lives of our residents. We firmly believe that when employees feel valued, our communities prosper. Guided by our foundational principles of integrity, compassion, teamwork, inclusion, growth, and customer service, we are dedicated to fostering an engaging and supportive workplace culture.
      
We are interested in finding talented individuals who are driven and empowered to become successful as they help build comfortable and welcoming communities. Throughout our company, you will find the guidance and support needed to inspire and challenge you to achieve success. Come join Team 11 in shaping exceptional living spaces for all!

Discover more at about us and our communities at

Position Summary
As a Renewal Specialist, you’ll be one of two members of a new centralized team focused on remotely managing lease renewals across our portfolio. You’ll own a high volume of renewals from outreach through signed lease, partnering with site teams to make sure resident concerns are heard and resolved.

Your responsibilities will include renewal communications, resident follow-up, leasing support and helping refine our retention strategies. Your work will directly affect resident retention and the stability and growth of our portfolio. This role is a chance to build lasting relationships and make sure residents feel valued and at home. On a scale of 1 to 10, we strive for an 11!

What you'll be doing
  • Manage high-volume customer outreach with timely communication and follow-up through renewal workflows.
  • Write, document, and plan clear, thoughtful written and verbal communications that promote resident retention and renewals.
  • Work with site-level office and maintenance teams to follow up on resident issues, concerns, and needs.
  • Support revenue management by applying renewal pricing guidelines and escalate issues outside the scope of the role to the appropriate leaders.
  • Track and report renewal and retention activity, including renewal status, notices to vacate, and reasons residents give for moving out.
  • Support leasing across multiple properties by managing the prospect queue, following up on leads, and scheduling tours and appointments for site teams.
  • Maintain accurate resident records, communication logs, and renewal documentation within the appropriate systems.
  • Share feedback and insights from resident interactions to help improve retention and renewals.
  • Ensure all resident and prospect communications comply with Fair Housing laws and company policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management based on business needs.
Education and Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in multifamily property management is required.
  • Proven track record of success in leasing and resident retention.
  • Strong sales and customer service skills, with a knack for building rapport and turning conversations into results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across phone, email, and text messaging.
  • Flexible, adaptable, and comfortable working in a new and evolving role.
  • Working knowledge of Fair Housing laws and lease renewal practices.
  • Proficiency in property management software required. Experience with Yardi, CRM IQ, RentCafe, and HappyCo preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, Excel, and Teams.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus.
  • Possess a high level of integrity and compassion with an emphasis on teamwork, inclusion, growth, and customer service.
  • Must be able to work remotely from home within an area and state where 11 Residential manages properties, and be able to occasionally travel to sites for in-person support.
  • Hold and maintain a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation.
  • A high school diploma or GED is required.
  • Must be able to work remotely from a home office with occasional travel to properties.
Compensation
  • The base compensation range for this position is $27 to $31 per hour (based on experience and skills).
  • In addition to the base pay, this role offers exciting opportunities for performance-driven commissions and tiered performance bonuses. Join us on this exciting journey where your hard work and dedication are not only valued but also rewarded. 
  • This position also offers a Work From Home Stipend of $450 for your home office setup.
  • Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 
Benefits
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverages.
  • Health savings account.
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match.
  • 30% Employee Rental Discount based on availability.
  • Mileage Stipend or reimbursement for travelling positions.
  • Education Reimbursement program.
  • Paid Time Off – Vacation, Sick, Paid Holidays, Birthday Holiday, Service Day, and Health & Wellness Day.
  • Exciting growth and development opportunities.

Physical Requirements
To successfully perform the essential functions of this job, the employee must be able to:
  • Perform work in a professional and home office environment.
  • Must be able to use standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and fax machines.
  • Regularly required to sit, and to move about the various work environments to train, monitor and ensure compliance with all company requirements.
  • This role requires the ability to walk the property (or properties) regularly, including climbing stairs, to show apartment homes and amenities to prospective residents.
  • The position may involve standing for extended periods and moving throughout the community in various weather conditions.
  • Verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers in person, virtually, and by phone.
  • Lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.
  • Travel to various worksites that may require overnight stays, flights, and/or prolonged travel in a vehicle.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of requirements for the work being performed by associates assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. 

EEO Statement
11Residential is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status with respect to recruitment, hiring, promotion and other terms and conditions of employment. 

You must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test. A positive result of Marijuana/THC does not disqualify candidates in states where it is legal.

Senior Consultant - HHS Collaboratives

What you will be doing:

The Senior Consultant works collaboratively within a team of highly qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare systems. This position will be primarily responsible for performing billable work for clients. The role of the Senior Consultant is to actively lead and participate in engagement work streams. Responsibilities include determining client needs in terms of the engagement statement of work; lead, complete and provide quality assurance over data analyses; interpret data analyses and form initial recommendations and develop potential solutions for consideration; develop deliverables and presentations materials for various audiences; assist in risk identification and mitigation; manage workstream economics and project management; and assist in the implementation of recommended improvements.

The Senior Consultant participates in all aspects of an engagement including identifying issues; forming hypotheses; planning and conducting interviews; planning, overseeing, and conducting analytics; developing recommendations and solutions for considerations; synthesizing information into cohesive presentations for various audiences and helping to implement change. The Senior Consultant will work in a team environment and provide input and support to team deliverables and presentations during each phase of a project. The Senior Consultant will also work on the project in daily management of project activities in the management of work stream activities including project management activities and project economic management.

The Senior Consultant is required to also participate in Premier internal activities including practice development, required, and approved educational opportunities throughout the year and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients. Additionally, the Senior Consultant should:

• Maintain utilization targets for client billable projects
• Create value through meaningful client interactions, data analytics and insights, and team participation on client projects
• Create value for the Advisory practice through meaningful participation on practice related activities aimed at
growing and enriching the Practice as a whole or individual Service Lines within the Practice

Analytics Focused Roles

Senior Consultants on the Analytics team will have expertise in Premier and PINC AI databases and methods of connecting existing and new datasets together to create enriched content used for analytics. This role interacts with clients, Premier internal product teams, and Advisory counterparts across all the service lines; and is expected to build working relationships within the Premier/Client team. They will lead production and quality assurance of client analytics deliverables and provide data-driven insights and solutions. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain dynamic and interactive data models based on Premier and client needs

  • Lead process standardization efforts.

  • Lead efforts to standardize and automate client deliverables and internal tools

  • Troubleshoot Tableau workbooks, SQL scripts, Excel analyses, etc.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1– 60%

• Obtain data, execute/direct/oversee analyses, initiate interpretations, and conclusions, and prepare verbal and graphic presentations, using methods that are professionally sound and efficient relative to project objectives and conform to standards. Perform quality assurance on assigned workstream deliverables.
• Assist in determining client needs by effectively participating in client interviews and utilizing various tools and analytical methods. Summarize analytical findings in a coherent manner and draw insight from observations, interviews, and data analyses. Develop accurate conclusions from findings. Drafts recommendations and potential solutions for team leadership review.
• Effectively execute on project plans in accordance with engagement statements of work and to client satisfaction.
• Develop presentations and deliverables for client audiences that communicate strategy and outcomes.
• Generate billings revenue by conducting assigned analyses, write and prepare reports, and assist clients in implementing desired changes.
• Participate in project management related activities as assigned regarding their work stream.
• Manage the budget and expenses for their assigned work stream.
• Participate in risk and issue identification and mitigation along with the project leadership team.

Responsibility #2 – 20%

• Participate in practice development activities for the Advisory Services Practice overall or for the Service Lines within the Practice.

Responsibility #3 – 10%

• Learn Premier based technologies and services.

Responsibility #4 – 5%

• Actively listens for market opportunities on current engagements and collaborative networks and communicates potential leads to managers.
• Contribute to the development of sales presentation deliverables using prescribed formats and technology; proactively seeks out opportunities to participate.
• Identifies opportunities to improve profitability

Responsibility #5 – 5%

• Complete all required training requirements on an annual basis.

​Required Qualifications

Work Experience:

Years of Applicable Experience - 4 or more years

Education:

Bachelors (Required)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

• Coordinate and deliver effective presentations (verbal and written) to client audiences to communicate project outcomes, recommendations, and strategy
• Ability to conduct analyses and oversee and mentor others in the delivery and production of client deliverables
• Ability to relate to clients and team members in an effective and collaborative manner
• Ability to lead work groups to successful outcomes

Analytics Focused Roles

• Lean Process Improvement; Six Sigma Green/Black belt

Experience:

• Experience in Health Systems Finance, Operations (clinical, support or operations), Operational or Strategic Consulting, Strategic Planning or Decision Support Analytics

Analytics Focused Roles

  • Experience analyzing complex healthcare data sets and developing visualizations and presentations to support data-driven recommendations
  • Experience with qualitative and quantitative data validation and analysis

Bachelor’s Degree, Master’s Degree

Qualified full-time and part-time employees also receive access to the following benefits:

raw.excerpt: Computer World Services, Corp.  (CWS) seeks Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These positions receive incidents and service requests, resolve approved first-contact and authorized Tier 2 issues, document interactions in ServiceNow, confirm restoration, and escalate issues requiring advanced assistance.

Analysts support hardware, software, networks, telecommunications, portals, system access, audio-visual equipment, and connectivity, and play an important role in recognizing and rapidly escalating potential outage signals to service-desk leadership and the Outage Response Team.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Serve as an initial point of contact, receiving incidents and requests via telephone, email, web, self-service, monitoring, and escalation channels.
    • Create complete ServiceNow records, verify customer and impact information, and categorize, prioritize, assign, and route tickets per approved procedures.
    • Resolve first-contact issues using approved procedures, scripts, knowledge articles, and remote-support tools.
    • Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, thin/zero clients, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, LAN/WAN/VPN/wireless connectivity, accounts, passwords, email, collaboration, and enterprise applications.
    • Apply approved workarounds and escalate incidents exceeding authority, capability, or scope to field support, engineering, cybersecurity, application, or vendor teams.
    • Recognize and immediately escalate outage signals, capturing symptoms, affected users and locations, start time, impact, and troubleshooting performed; support Severity (SEV) 1 and SEV 2 response.
    • Own assigned tickets through resolution, keep customers informed of status and next steps, confirm restoration and satisfaction before closure, and reopen or re-escalate when issues recur.
    • Participate in shift handoffs and support VIP incidents and requests per priority-support procedures.
    • Identify recurring incidents and knowledge gaps, recommend new or updated articles or automated resolutions, and contribute to problem and known-error records.
    • Protect sensitive information, meet response and resolution targets, and provide ticket and queue data for status reports.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Associate’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Minimum of three (3) years of relevant service-desk, help-desk, desktop-support, or end-user support experience.
    • Experience documenting, troubleshooting, resolving, and escalating incidents and requests using an enterprise ITSM platform.
    • Working knowledge of hardware, operating systems, productivity software, user accounts, networks, remote access, and enterprise applications.
    • Ability to recognize and escalate potential outages and maintain complete, accurate ticket documentation.
    • Strong customer-service and communication skills, and ability to work assigned shifts and after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage.

      • Preferred:

      • Experience using ServiceNow in a multi-tier enterprise service desk supporting federal or DoD users.
      • Experience supporting geographically dispersed users in a 24/7/365 environment, including VIP or executive users.
      • Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, and service-level practices.
      • Experience with remote-support, endpoint-management, directory-services, or knowledge-management tools.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Must work assigned shifts within the program’s operating schedule and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.

      • Administrative Notes:

      Period of Performance: March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033

      Contract Start Date: March 1, 2027

      Note: By applying to this position, the candidate acknowledges and consents to having their resume included in an active competitive Government contract bid.

raw.description:
About First Gen Financial

We’re a fast-growing, purpose-driven B2B financial services company built on integrity, accountability, and continuous growth. We have developed our own proprietary insurance product for employers which is scaling rapidly. Our leadership team brings proven expertise from multiple sectors of finance, and every team member plays a direct role in expanding both our clients’ success and our company’s vision. We unlock capital to empower teams!

About the role

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the primary point of contact for clients & members, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our products and services. This role is responsible for building long-term relationships, driving adoption, and proactively addressing customer needs to reduce churn and increase satisfaction. You will be working closely with the Director of Customer Success on process improvement and automation. This is a high growth opportunity and career progression and ownership of CS is on the horizon for the right individual.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships.
  • Serve as the main liaison between clients and internal teams, advocating for customer needs.
  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, and implementation to ensure successful adoption.
  • Support clients through payroll-related workflows, integrations, and time-sensitive processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with benefits administration.
  • Monitor customer usage and proactively identify opportunities to improve engagement and outcomes.
  • Address client issues promptly, collaborating with support and product teams to ensure resolution.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and provide insights to customers on performance and ROI.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of client accounts post-implementation, driving retention, adoption, and long-term value.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in CRM & process management systems.

Skills

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize effectively, and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and customer success tools.
  • A consultative, customer-first mindset with a focus on delivering measurable value.

Other Requirements

  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Occasional evening or weekend availability may be required to support client training sessions or critical payroll-related activities.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Working with internal and external clients to support our employers and employees on our health plan
  • Working on pre-launch and post-launch directives
  • Heavy Excel work for reporting and analysis

Requirements

  • Education & Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing roles (preferably in SaaS or technology-driven environments).
  • Experience with professional services for finance and/or insurance a plus.
  • Experience working with payroll systems, payroll integrations, or HRIS platforms (e.g., payroll providers, benefits administration, or related services) is a big plus.

Who You Are

You’re an A-Player. coachable, driven, and deeply mission-aligned. You thrive on ownership, competition, and personal growth. You embody First Gen’s core values:

- Ironclad Integrity: You do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

- 24-Carat Accountability: You own your outcomes and stay humble when corrected.

- Catalyst: You’re a constant learner with curiosity, discipline, and resilience.

- Wholehearted: You put relationships before deals and build authentic trust.

You’re not just looking for another sales job you’re seeking a purposeful career where your work directly impacts business owners and their teams.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Fully remote role.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Performance-based bonuses or commission opportunities.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement plan options.
  • Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities.
  • Compensation for this position is dependent on location, experience, and other requirements.
  • Current Estimated Base Compensation: $60,000 - $70,000

Equal Opportunity Statement

First Gen Industries LTD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
